Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant
to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Enclosure Management Module (EMM) firmware version mismatch detected in arg1.arg2 arg3.
records.explanation: The firmware on the EMM modules is not the same version. Both modules must have the same firmware version. This message is caused when you attempt to insert an EMM module that has a different firmware version than an existing module.
records.recommended_action:
Upgrade to the same version of the firmware on both EMM modules and then powercycle the system
and attached enclosures.

messages: arg1 is shutdown.
records.explanation: The physical disk enclosure is either hotter or cooler than the maximum or minimum allowable temperature range.
records.recommended_action:
Check for factors that may cause overheating or excessive cooling. For example, verify that the
enclosure fan is working. You should also check the thermostat settings and examine whether the
enclosure is located near a heat source. Make sure the enclosure has enough ventilation and that
the room temperature is not too hot or too cold. Refer to the enclosure documentation for more
diagnostic information.

messages: Firmware download on arg1 has failed.
records.explanation: The system was unable to download firmware to the enclosure. The controller may have lost communication with the enclosure. There may have been problems with the data transfer or the download media may be corrupt.
records.cause: The system was unable to download firmware to the enclosure. The controller may have lost communication with the enclosure. There may have been problems with the data transfer or the download media may be corrupt.
records.recommended_action:
Attempt to download the enclosure firmware again. If problems continue, verify that the controller can
communicate with the enclosure. Make sure that the enclosure is powered ON. Refer to the storage
hardware documentation for information on checking the cables.

messages: arg1 firmware mismatch.
records.explanation: The firmware on the EMM modules is not the same version. It is required that both modules have the same version of the firmware. This alert may be caused when you attempt to insert an EMM module that has a different firmware version than an existing module.
records.cause: The firmware on the EMM modules is not the same version. It is required that both modules have the same version of the firmware. This alert may be caused when you attempt to insert an EMM module that has a different firmware version than an existing module.
records.recommended_action: Download the same version of the firmware to both EMM modules.

messages: The Enclosure Management Module (EMM) arg1 installed in sled that is available in slot arg2 has failed.
records.explanation: The Enclosure Management Module (EMM) installed in sled that is available in slot identified in the message has failed either because 1) Power loss to the Expander Module. 2) The Expander self-test may also have identified a failure. 3) A firmware issue. 4) Multi- bit error.
records.cause: The Enclosure Management Module (EMM) installed in sled that is available in slot identified in the message has failed either because 1) Power loss to the Expander Module. 2) The Expander self-test may also have identified a failure. 3) A firmware issue. 4) Multi- bit error.
records.recommended_action:
Reset the Expander Module. For information about resetting or replacing the Expander Module ,
see the Storage hardware documentation available on the support site. If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: The redundant multipath connection to the enclosure arg1 is abruptly disconnected because either the EMM is removed, cable is damaged, the cable is removed, a SAS IO Module is powered off, is damaged or is removed.
records.explanation: The redundant multipath connection to the enclosure identified in the message abruptly disconnected because either the EMM is removed, cable is damaged, the cable is removed, a SAS IOM module is powered off, is damaged or is removed.
records.cause: The redundant multipath connection to the enclosure identified in the message abruptly disconnected because either the EMM is removed, cable is damaged, the cable is removed, a SAS IOM module is powered off, is damaged or is removed.
records.recommended_action:
Do one of the following: 1) Make sure that the cables are properly connected to the Controller. 2)
If the Enclosure Management Module (EMM) is removed, reinsert the EMM. 3) Check the status of
both SAS IO modules (IOM). If a SAS IO module is removed, reinsert the SAS IOM.

messages: An error has occurred in the enclosure or backplane arg1 because of a component count mismatch, which has resulted in the degraded state of enclosure or backplane.
records.explanation: Because of an issue in communication between the enclosure and RAID controller, any or all of the following counts may mismatch: slot count, EMM count, temperature probe count, PSU count, and fan count.
records.cause: Because of an issue in communication between the enclosure and RAID controller, any or all of the following counts may mismatch: slot count, EMM count, temperature probe count, PSU count, and fan count.
records.recommended_action: Restart the server or perform the Power Cycle operation on the enclosure.

messages: A storage topology error is detected on arg1.
records.explanation: A storage topology issue is detected on the controller identified in the message. Some of the possible reasons are: 1) Incorrect cable connections such as loose, damaged, or improperly routed SAS cables. 2) Firmware incompatibility such as different SAS devices (like RAID controllers and expanders) might require the same firmware version to work correctly within a topology. 3) Exceeding enclosure limits such as a SAS controller may only support a certain number of enclosures, and connecting more than supported can cause an error. 4) Unsupported devices in the configuration.
records.cause: A storage topology issue is detected on the controller identified in the message. Some of the possible reasons are: 1) Incorrect cable connections such as loose, damaged, or improperly routed SAS cables. 2) Firmware incompatibility such as different SAS devices (like RAID controllers and expanders) might require the same firmware version to work correctly within a topology. 3) Exceeding enclosure limits such as a SAS controller may only support a certain number of enclosures, and connecting more than supported can cause an error. 4) Unsupported devices in the configuration.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following: 1) Check whether expander and backplane firmware are compatible and upgrade
the firmware if required. 2) Remove the un-supported device from the configuration. 3) See the
respective PERC Users Guide or the Installation and Service Manual (ISM) of the respective server
platform on the supported number of device configurations.

messages: Redundancy on arg1 is degraded
records.explanation: One or more of the enclosure components has failed. For example, a fan or power supply may have failed. Although the enclosure is currently operational, the failure of additional components could cause the enclosure to fail.
records.recommended_action:
Identify and replace the failed component. To identify the failed component, select the enclosure in
the tree view and click the Health subtab. Any failed component will be identified with a red X on
the enclosures Health subtab. Alternatively, you can select the Storage object and click the Health
subtab. The controller status displayed on the Health subtab indicates whether a controller has a failed
or degraded component. See the enclosure documentation for information on replacing enclosure
components and for other diagnostic information.

messages: Communication timeout on arg1.
records.explanation: The controller is unable to communicate with an enclosure. There are several reasons for communication loss. For example, there may be a bad or loose cable. An unusual amount of I/O may also interrupt communication with the enclosure. In addition, communication loss may be caused by software, hardware, or firmware problems, bad or failed power supplies, and enclosure shutdown.
records.cause: The controller is unable to communicate with an enclosure. There are several reasons for communication loss. For example, there may be a bad or loose cable. An unusual amount of I/O may also interrupt communication with the enclosure. In addition, communication loss may be caused by software, hardware, or firmware problems, bad or failed power supplies, and enclosure shutdown.
records.recommended_action:
Check for problems with the cables. See the Cables attached correctly section for more information
on checking the cables. You should also check to see if the enclosure has degraded or failed
components. To do this, select the enclosure object in the tree view and click the Health subtab.
The Health subtab displays the status of the enclosure components. Verify that the controller has
the supported driver and firmware versions installed and that each Enclosure Management Modules
(EMMs) are running the same version of supported firmware.

messages: Unable to use the Extended Power Performance (EPP) feature on chassis.
records.explanation: The Extended Power Performance cannot be used unless chassis has six EPP capable PSUs, Configure the Power Redundancy Policy to Grid Redundancy & MPCM, DPSE, SBPM and Fresh Air features should be disabled.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that chassis has six EPP capable PSUs, Configure the Power Redundancy Policy to Grid
Redundancy & MPCM, DPSE, SBPM and Fresh Air features should be disabled. Then enable the EPP
feature.

messages: Unable to use the Extended Power Performance (EPP) feature because the Dynamic Power Supply Engagement mode is enabled.
records.explanation: The Extended Power Performance cannot be used because the Dynamic Power Supply Engagement mode is enabled.
records.cause: The Extended Power Performance cannot be used because the Dynamic Power Supply Engagement mode is enabled.
records.recommended_action: Disable the Dynamic Power Supply Engagement mode and then retry to enable the EPP feature.

messages: Unable to use the Extended Power Performance (EPP) feature because the Chassis Management Controller (CMC) firmware update is in progress.
records.explanation: The Extended Power Performance cannot be used because the Chassis Management Controller (CMC) firmware update is in progress.
records.cause: The Extended Power Performance cannot be used because the Chassis Management Controller (CMC) firmware update is in progress.
records.recommended_action: Wait for the firmware update to complete, and then retry to enable the EPP feature.

messages: Unable to use the Extended Power Performance (EPP) feature because the Chassis Management Controller (CMC) failover process is in progress.
records.explanation: The Extended Power Performance is cannot be used because the Chassis Management Controller (CMC) failover process is in progress.
records.cause: The Extended Power Performance is cannot be used because the Chassis Management Controller (CMC) failover process is in progress.
records.recommended_action: Wait for the failover process to complete, and then retry to enable the EPP feature.

messages: Unable to use the Extended Power Performance (EPP) feature because the power supply unit (PSU) slot - arg1 is empty.
records.explanation: The Extended Power Performance cannot be used because the power supply unit (PSU) slot identified in the message is empty.
records.cause: The Extended Power Performance cannot be used because the power supply unit (PSU) slot identified in the message is empty.
records.recommended_action: Install an EPP-capable PSU in the empty slot, and then retry to enable the EPP feature.

messages: Unable to use the Extended Power Performance (EPP) feature because the power supply unit (PSU) slot - arg1 has no input power.
records.explanation: The Extended Power Performance cannot be used because the power supply unit (PSU) slot identified in the message has no power supply.
records.cause: The Extended Power Performance cannot be used because the power supply unit (PSU) slot identified in the message has no power supply.
records.recommended_action: Make sure that the PSU in the PSU slot has input power, and then retry to enable the EPP feature.

messages: Unable to use the Extended Power Performance (EPP) feature because the power supply unit (PSU) slot - arg1 has no output power.
records.explanation: The Extended Power Performance cannot be used because the power supply unit (PSU) slot identified in the message has no output power.
records.cause: The Extended Power Performance cannot be used because the power supply unit (PSU) slot identified in the message has no output power.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that the PSU in the PSU slot has no issue in the output power, and then retry to enable
the EPP feature. To check the health status of the PSU identified in the message using the RACADM
CLI utility, enter the following command: "racadm getpbinfo". If the PSU identified in the message is
showing no output power, contact your service provider.

messages: Unable to use the Extended Power Performance (EPP) feature because the power rating of power supply unit (PSU) slot - arg1 is less than 3000W.
records.explanation: The Extended Power Performance cannot be used because the power rating of PSU identified in the slot is less than 3000W.
records.cause: The Extended Power Performance cannot be used because the power rating of PSU identified in the slot is less than 3000W.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that there are at least six PSUs in the chassis and each PSU must be of 3000W capacity,
and then retry to enable the EPP feature.

messages: Fan arg1 RPM is less than the lower warning threshold.
records.explanation: The fan is not performing optimally. The fan may be installed improperly or may be failing. Fan speeds may have increased to protect the system.
records.cause: The fan is not performing optimally. The fan may be installed improperly or may be failing. Fan speeds may have increased to protect the system.
records.recommended_action:
Remove and re-install the fan at the next scheduled service window. If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: Fan arg1 RPM is less than the lower critical threshold.
records.explanation: The fan is not performing optimally. The fan may be installed improperly or may be failing. Fan speedsmay have increased to protect the system.
records.cause: The fan is not performing optimally. The fan may be installed improperly or may be failing. Fan speedsmay have increased to protect the system.
records.recommended_action:
To resolve any temporary issues in communicating with the fans, restart iDRAC. If the issue persists,
do the following: 1) Open the chassis cover and check for any cable interference in the fan blades. 2)
Remove the fan (as identified in the iDRAC log) from the server and then reinstall in the same slot. 3)
Make sure the fan is removed from its connector on the motherboard. 4) Swap the fan with another
fan from a different location in the same server. 5) If the issue persists, replace the fan with a new
fan. 6) After installing the new fan in the slot, if the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection
(TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic
to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Fan arg1 RPM is greater than the upper warning threshold.
records.explanation: The fan is not performing optimally. The fan may be installed improperly or may be failing.
records.cause: The fan is not performing optimally. The fan may be installed improperly or may be failing.
records.recommended_action:
Remove and re-install the fan at the next scheduled service window. If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: Fan arg1 RPM is outside of range.
records.explanation: The fan is not performing optimally. The fan may be installed improperly or may be failing.
records.cause: The fan is not performing optimally. The fan may be installed improperly or may be failing.
records.recommended_action:
Remove and re-install the fan. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report
using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the
Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Fan arg1 is absent.
records.explanation: The fan may be required for optimal performance.
records.recommended_action: If unintentional, install a fan.

messages: The arg1 is non-functional.
records.explanation: The fan identified in the message has failed or it is not installed correctly.
records.recommended_action:
Remove and re-install the fan or replace the fan, and open the OMSA Web interface to verify if the
fan specified in the message is displayed correctly. If the issue persists, contact your service provider.

messages: The arg1 sensor has failed, and the last recorded value by the sensor was arg2 RPM.
records.explanation: The sensor identified in the message has failed. The sensor may be required for optimal system performance.
records.recommended_action:
Check the Embedded System Management (ESM) Log for any sensor related faults. If the fan sensor
has failed, replace the system board. For more information, contact your service provider.

messages: Unable to read the arg1 sensor value.
records.explanation: The fan sensor identified in the message has failed or the fan has failed.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following: 1) Remove the old fan, install a new fan and power cycle the system to check if
the fan is working properly, 2) Replace the system board if the fan sensor has failed. 3) If the issue
persists, contact your service provider.

messages: The arg1 sensor state has changed to a warning state with a value of arg2 RPM.
records.explanation: The fan identified in the message is not functioning correctly. The fan may be installed incorrectly or may be failing.
records.cause: The fan identified in the message is not functioning correctly. The fan may be installed incorrectly or may be failing.
records.recommended_action: Remove and re-install the fan, or replace the fan. If the issue persists, contact your service provider.

messages: The arg1 sensor detected an error with a value of arg2 RPM.
records.explanation: The fan sensor identified in the message indicates that the related fan has exceeded critical RPM thresholds.
records.recommended_action:
Remove and re-install the fan, or replace the fan with a new fan. If the issue persists, contact your
service provider.

messages: The arg1 sensor has failed with a value of arg2 RPM.
records.explanation: The sensor identified in the message has failed. The sensor may be required for optimal system performance.
records.recommended_action:
Check the Embedded System Management (ESM) Log for any sensor related faults. If the fan sensor
has failed, replace the system board. For more information, contact your service provider.

messages: Fan arg1 is either removed, incorrectly installed, or not present.
records.explanation: The fan identified in the message is either removed, incorrectly installed, or not present. Fan speeds may increase to protect the system.
records.recommended_action: Install the fan at the next scheduled service.

messages: Fan arg1 configuration mismatch.
records.explanation: The configuration of fan identified in the message is not matching with the other fans in the server.
records.recommended_action:
Replace the fan with one that has similar configuration during the next scheduled service. For more
information about recommended fan configurations, see the iDRAC Users Guide available on the
support site.

messages: The communication with arg1 fan arg2 is lost.
records.explanation: The communication with the fan identified in the message is lost.
records.recommended_action:
If absent, insert a fan. If the fan is present, remove and reseat into the enclosure. If the issue
persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/
support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and
recommend a resolution.

messages: The speed (RPM) of the arg1 fan arg2 is less than the lower warning threshold.
records.explanation: The speed (RPM) of the fan identified in the message is less than the lower warning threshold value.
records.recommended_action:
Remove and reinstall the device during the next scheduled service window. If the issue persists,
Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/
incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and
recommend a resolution.

messages: The speed (RPM) of the arg1 fan arg2 is less than the lower critical threshold.
records.explanation: The speed (RPM) of the fan identified in the message is less than the lower critical threshold value.
records.recommended_action:
Remove and reinstall the device during the next scheduled service window. If the issue persists,
Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/
incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and
recommend a resolution.

messages: An issue in the chassis infrastructure hardware or arg1 fan arg2 has affected the chassis thermal control feature.
records.explanation: An issue in the chassis infrastructure hardware or fan module identified in the message has affected the chassis thermal control feature. However, the chassis thermal control feature is temporarily recovered.
records.recommended_action:
If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://
www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze
the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: The speed (RPM) of the arg1 is less than the lower Warning threshold value.
records.explanation: The speed (RPM) of the fan identified in the message is less than the lower Warning threshold value.
records.recommended_action:
Remove, clean, inspect and reinstall the fan module at the earliest convenience. Refer to the
Integrated Rack Controller Installation and Service Manual available on the support site.

messages: The speed (RPM) of the arg1 is less than the lower Critical threshold value.
records.explanation: The speed (RPM) of the fan identified in the message is less than the lower Critical threshold value.
records.recommended_action:
Remove, clean, inspect and reinstall the fan module at the earliest convenience. Refer to the
Integrated Rack Controller Installation and Service Manual available on the support site.

messages: The fan arg1 is disabled because of a hardware issue.
records.explanation: The speed (RPM) of the fan identified in the message is disabled because of a hardware issue.
records.recommended_action:
Remove and reseat the cable connection from the IRC to the fan module. Refer to the Integrated
Rack Controller Installation and Service Manual available on the support site.

messages: The eRDHx fans are running in test mode while the eRDHx thermal controls are disabled.
records.explanation: The Enclosed Rear Door Heat Exchanger (eRDHx) fans are running in test mode while eRDHx thermal controls are powered off. The eRDHx is not providing cooling to the rack in test mode. The test mode continues until it is disabled or thermal controls are powered on.
records.recommended_action:
When testing is completed, disable the test mode and power on the eRDHx thermal controls. For
more information about the eRDHx, see the Integrated Rack Controller Installation and Service Manual
available on the support site.

messages: Unable to update the firmware version of the arg1 fan arg2 because of error code = arg3.
records.explanation: The firmware version of the fan identified in the message cannot be updated because of internal issues.
records.recommended_action:
Manually remove and reinstall the fan during the next scheduled service window. If the issue, persists,
contact your service provider.

messages: arg1 fan arg2 configuration mismatch.
records.explanation: The configuration of the fan identified in the message is not matching with the other fans in the chassis. Some devices may experience varied performance and possible thermal errors depending on the configuration and workload.
records.recommended_action:
Replace the fan with one that matches the configuration and type of fan inside MX7000 at the
next scheduled service. Dell recommends as soon as possible for optimal performance. For more
information about recommended fan configurations, see the MX7000 Users Guide available on the
support site.

messages: arg1 was removed.
records.explanation: The enclosure detected that a fan was removed and the enclosure is no longer functioning in optimal condition.
records.recommended_action:
Re-insert the fan into the enclosure. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: arg1 has failed.
records.explanation: The enclosure detected that a fan has failed and the enclosure is no longer functioning in optimal condition.
records.recommended_action:
If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://
www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze
the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: The Chassis was turned off because more than two internal fans stopped functioning.
records.explanation: The Chassis was turned off because more than two Chassis internal fans stopped functioning. The fans with issues are identified in the CMC Hardware (System Event Log) and Chassis Logs.
records.cause: The Chassis was turned off because more than two Chassis internal fans stopped functioning. The fans with issues are identified in the CMC Hardware (System Event Log) and Chassis Logs.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that the Chassis internal fans are functioning. At the command line interface (CLI), enter
the following command to identify fans that are not functioning: "racadm getsel". Using the CMC Web
GUI, select the chassis, click the Logs tab, and then select Hardware Log. Reinsert or replace fans
that are not functioning correctly.

messages: Cannot enable the Enhanced Cooling Mode because an unsupported fan is inserted in the Chassis.
records.explanation: The Enhanced Cooling Mode cannot be enabled because an unsupported fan is present in the Chassis.
records.cause: The Enhanced Cooling Mode cannot be enabled because an unsupported fan is present in the Chassis.
records.recommended_action:
Insert a fan that is supported by the Chassis, and then retry the operation. For a list of fans that are
supported by Chassis, see the Chassis Management Controller Users Guide.

messages: The attempt to enable the Enhanced Cooling Mode was not successful.
records.explanation: The attempt to enable the Enhanced Cooling Mode (ECM) was not successful because ECM is already enabled or Gen3 fans are not present in the Chassis.
records.cause: The attempt to enable the Enhanced Cooling Mode (ECM) was not successful because ECM is already enabled or Gen3 fans are not present in the Chassis.
records.recommended_action:
Check whether or not the Enhanced Cooling Mode (ECM) is already enabled. Make sure there are
Gen3 fans in the Chassis and retry the operation.

messages: Unable to perform the operation due to an internal error in iDRAC.
records.explanation: An internal error occurred in iDRAC and the operation cannot continue. An iDRAC reset is required to recover from the error.
records.recommended_action:
Disconnect the AC power source from the system, reconnect the power source, and retry the
operation.

messages: SCSI Target FibreChannel Port arg1 is offline.
records.explanation: The port identified in the message is offline.
records.recommended_action:
Gather a SupportAssist collection (TSR) using iDRAC. Visit www.dell.com/support to use the Virtual
Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: SCSI Target FibreChannel Port arg1 encountered an error, resulting in the generation of excessive cores for the HBA. Disabling port arg2.
records.explanation: SCSI Target FibreChannel Port identified in the message encountered an error, resulting in the generation of excessive cores for the HBA. Disabling Port.
records.recommended_action:
Gather a SupportAssist collection (TSR) using iDRAC. Visit www.dell.com/support to use the Virtual
Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: SCSI Target FibreChannel Port arg1 encountered an error and was unable to access HBA resources. Disabling port arg2.
records.explanation: SCSI Target FibreChannel Port identified in the message encountered an error and was unable to access HBA resources. Disabling Port.
records.recommended_action:
Gather a SupportAssist collection (TSR) using iDRAC. Visit www.dell.com/support to use the Virtual
Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: The arg1 Port arg2 network link is down.
records.explanation: The FC controller port link is down. Either the FC cable is not connected or the FC device is not working.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following: 1) Make sure that the FC port is enabled. 2) Make sure the Activity/Speed LEDs
are lit if the physical port has LEDs. 3) Check the FC cable and FC cable connections for proper
installation. 4) Check that the attached FC switch is functioning.

messages: Unable to activate the arg1. The chassis service tag is unavailable.
records.explanation: The CMC is not responding. The chassis has the factory-programmed service tag.
records.recommended_action: Contact your service provider.

messages: Caching was enabled in write-back mode, but it is currently operating in write-through mode.
records.explanation: Caching was enabled in write-back mode but currently it is operating in write-through mode because the fluid Cache Pool has one PCIe-SSD.
records.cause: Caching was enabled in write-back mode but currently it is operating in write-through mode because the fluid Cache Pool has one PCIe-SSD.
records.recommended_action: Add another PCIe SSD device to the Fluid Cache Pool to resolve the issue.

messages: Caching was enabled in write-back or write-through mode, it is currently operating in pass-through mode.
records.explanation: Caching was enabled in write-back mode or write through mode, but currently it is operating in write-through mode because fluid Cache Pool has no PCIe-SSD device.
records.recommended_action: Add another PCIe SSD device to the Fluid Cache Pool to resolve the issue.

messages: Debug authorization failed; for debugCaps: arg1, authorized by iDRAC user: arg2, and Dell employee: arg3, at arg4 for the period: arg5 to arg6.
records.explanation: A RACADM Debug command failed. If the RACADM Debug command was executed under the direction of Dell tech support then further assistance from tech support should be requested. Otherwise this command is not intended for customer use.
records.recommended_action:
Verify all of the following 1) ensure that the unblock, grant, and invoke/start/stop/resume commands
are all executed against the same iDRAC. 2) ensure dat.ini file has not been changed in any way. 3)
ensure that current date falls between the start and end times. Note that Dell can further restrict
both the set of debugCaps that is authorized and the start and stop times. If an authorized person did
not enter a RACADM debug command then an attacker may have entered the command.

messages: Unable to complete the configuration clone operation either because of a firmware mismatch between Primary Group Controller and Group Member or because of network issues.
records.explanation: The configuration clone operation cannot be completed either because of a firmware mismatch between Primary Group Controller and Group Member or because of network issues.
records.cause: The configuration clone operation cannot be completed either because of a firmware mismatch between Primary Group Controller and Group Member or because of network issues.
records.recommended_action:
See iDRAC Group Manager job view for information about recommended correction action. In case
of a firmware mismatch, ensure the firmware versions match each other by performing a firmware
update.

messages: The iDRAC local group could not identify a Secondary Controller either because of firmware incompatibility between primary controller and members, or because the local group does not have a second member to select.
records.explanation: The iDRAC local group could not identify a Secondary Controller either because of firmware incompatibility between primary controller and members, or because the local group does not have a second member to select.
records.cause: The iDRAC local group could not identify a Secondary Controller either because of firmware incompatibility between primary controller and members, or because the local group does not have a second member to select.
records.recommended_action:
To enable redundancy, make sure that there is at least one more member that has the supported
firmware version for the Controller capability.

messages: Unable to upgrade the firmware because the image file cannot be downloaded.
records.explanation: The firmware version cannot be upgraded because the image file cannot be downloaded.
records.cause: The firmware version cannot be upgraded because the image file cannot be downloaded.
records.recommended_action: For information about a resolution to this issue, see the iDRAC Group Manager job view.

messages: Unable to update the firmware version of server in the group because the firmware is invalid for this platform.
records.explanation: Unable to update the firmware version of server in the group because the firmware is invalid for this platform.
records.cause: Unable to update the firmware version of server in the group because the firmware is invalid for this platform.
records.recommended_action: Use the firmware version recommended for wider platform specification and group update.

messages: Unable to update the firmware version of the server because the firmware update feature is not supported by the iDRAC version currently installed on this server.
records.explanation: The firmware version of the group cannot be updated because the firmware update feature is not supported by the iDRAC version currently installed on this server.
records.cause: The firmware version of the group cannot be updated because the firmware update feature is not supported by the iDRAC version currently installed on this server.
records.recommended_action: Update the iDRAC version of the server to version 4.40.00.00 and later, and then retry the operation.

messages: Duplicate iDRAC groups are existing because of incompatible iDRAC firmware versions.
records.explanation: Duplicate iDRAC groups are existing because of incompatible iDRAC firmware versions.
records.cause: Duplicate iDRAC groups are existing because of incompatible iDRAC firmware versions.
records.recommended_action:
Update to the latest iDRAC firmware version to make sure that the iDRAC versions on all members are
the same.

messages: The device is unable to join the iDRAC local group because an incompatible iDRAC firmware version is detected.
records.explanation: The device is unable to join the iDRAC local group because an incompatible iDRAC firmware version is detected.
records.cause: The device is unable to join the iDRAC local group because an incompatible iDRAC firmware version is detected.
records.recommended_action:
Update the latest iDRAC firmware version on the server and retry the operation. To update iDRAC by
using iDRAC GUI, click (Maintenance > System Update > Manual Update). By using RACADM, run the
following at the Command Line Interface (CLI): "racadm update".

messages: The NVIDIA Baseboard Management Controller is unresponsive.
records.explanation: The NVIDIA Baseboard Management Controller is unresponsive. A recovery operation must be performed by updating the component firmware.
records.recommended_action:
Download and install the latest Dell Update package (DUP) for the NVIDIA HGX Baseboard
Management Controller (HMC) firmware. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection
(TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic
to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: The NVIDIA Baseboard Management Controller is unresponsive.
records.explanation: The NVIDIA Baseboard Management Controller is unresponsive, and a recovery operation must be performed.
records.recommended_action:
Perform an AC Cycle operation on the server and verify if the issue is resolved. If the issue
persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/
support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and
recommend a resolution.

messages: Unable to recover the Nvidia HGX Baseboard Management Controller (HMC). One or more recovery attempts from iDRAC failed because HMC was not ready.
records.explanation: The status of Nvidia HGX Baseboard Management Controller (HMC) cannot be recovered. One or more recovery attempts from iDRAC failed because HMC was not ready.
records.cause: The status of Nvidia HGX Baseboard Management Controller (HMC) cannot be recovered. One or more recovery attempts from iDRAC failed because HMC was not ready.
records.recommended_action:
Perform an AC Power Cycle operation. If the Nvidia HGX Baseboard Management Controller status
cannot be recovered, If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using
iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual
Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: iDRAC or BMC exited because the arg1 Host Processor Module FRU is not programmed. See the message arg2.
records.explanation: iDRAC or BMC exited because the Host Processor Module Field Replaceable Unit (FRU) is not programmed on the device.
records.cause: iDRAC or BMC exited because the Host Processor Module Field Replaceable Unit (FRU) is not programmed on the device.
records.recommended_action:
Perform an AC Power Cycle operation by doing the following: 1) Disconnect the power cords from the
server. 2) Wait 30 seconds. 3) Reconnect the power cords to the server. If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: iDRAC or BMC exited because an unsupported arg1 Host Processor Module vendor name is detected. See the message: arg2.
records.explanation: iDRAC or BMC exited because an unsupported vendor of the Host Processor Module is detected.
records.cause: iDRAC or BMC exited because an unsupported vendor of the Host Processor Module is detected.
records.recommended_action:
Perform an AC Power Cycle operation by doing the following: 1) Disconnect the power cords from the
server. 2) Wait 30 seconds. 3) Reconnect the power cords to the server. If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: iDRAC or BMC exited because the Intrusion Cable is removed from the server. See the message: arg1.
records.explanation: iDRAC or BMC exited because the intrusion cable is disconnected from the server.
records.cause: iDRAC or BMC exited because the intrusion cable is disconnected from the server.
records.recommended_action:
1) Disconnect the power cords from the server. 2) Connect the intrusion cable. 3) Reconnect the
power cords to the server. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using
iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual
Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Unable to start iDRAC or BMC due to mismatched Host Processor Module FRU identifiers. See message HPM0005.
records.explanation: iDRAC or Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) exited because the secondary Host Processor Module Field Replaceable Unit (FRU) Identifier (hpm_type), does not match with the primary.
records.cause: iDRAC or Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) exited because the secondary Host Processor Module Field Replaceable Unit (FRU) Identifier (hpm_type), does not match with the primary.
records.recommended_action:
Perform an AC Power Cycle operation by doing the following: 1) Disconnect the power cords from
the server. 2) Wait for 30 seconds. 3) Reconnect the power cords to the server. If the issue
persists, collecting a SupportAssist collection (TSR) may not be possible. Visithttps://www.dell.com/
support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamicto use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and
recommend a resolution.

messages: Unable to detect the Host Processor Module FRU data on the system because of hardware reason.
records.explanation: iDRAC or Baseboard management Controller (BMC) cannot read or access the Host Processor Module (HPM) Field Replaceable Unit (FRU) data because of hardware reason.
records.recommended_action:
Perform an AC Power Cycle operation by doing the following: 1) Disconnect the power cords from
the server. 2) Wait for 30 seconds. 3) Reconnect the power cords to the server. If the issue
persists, reseat the DC-SCM. If the issue still persists, collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visithttps://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamicto use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Unable to upgrade the Heater Manager Subsystem firmware version because the heating status of one or more heater zones are enabled (ON).
records.explanation: The firmware version of the Heater Manager Subsystem was not upgraded because the heating status of one or more heater zones are enabled (ON).
records.cause: The firmware version of the Heater Manager Subsystem was not upgraded because the heating status of one or more heater zones are enabled (ON).
records.recommended_action: Make sure that the heating status of all the heater zones are disabled (Off) and retry the operation.

messages: Unable to upgrade the Heater Manager Subsystem firmware version. Error=arg1, (arg2).
records.explanation: The firmware version of the Heater Manager Subsystem was not upgraded because of internal communication errors.
records.cause: The firmware version of the Heater Manager Subsystem was not upgraded because of internal communication errors.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the firmware update operation. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Unable to recover the firmware of arg1. The subsystem is not communicating with iDRAC.
records.explanation: Corrupted firmware of the subsystem identified in the message cannot be recovered. The subsystem is not communicating with iDRAC.
records.recommended_action:
If the issue persists,Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://
www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze
the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: A hardware issue has occurred in the Heater Manager Subsystem. The required sensor arg1 for the arg2 zone is not present.
records.explanation: A hardware issue has occurred in the Heater Manager Subsystem. A sensor for the identified zone in the message is not present.
records.recommended_action:
Power off the server and ensure that the sensor cable is properly connected to the zone identified
in the message. If the issue persists then provide this iDRAC Lifecycle log to the Technical Support
team.

messages: A hardware issue is detected in the Heater Manager subsystem. The required sensor cable arg1 for the arg2 zone is removed or uninstalled.
records.explanation: A hardware issue is detected in the Heater Manager subsystem. A sensor cable for the zone identified in the message is removed or uninstalled.
records.recommended_action:
Power off the server and ensure that the sensor cable assembly for the zone identified in the message
is fully connected to the correct connector. To identify the cable, see the service information printed
in the label on the chassis cover or the Cable Routing section in the Installation and Service Manual
(ISM) of the respective server model available on the support site. If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: Unable to initialize vFlash SD card.
records.explanation: The vFlash SD card is incorrectly inserted, the vFlash SD card is faulty, or there is an iDRAC communication failure.
records.recommended_action:
Reinsert or replace the vFlash SD card, or reset iDRAC, and retry the operation. If the problem
persists: 1) Turn off the system and disconnect the power cord. 2) Wait for five seconds. 3)
Reconnect the power cord, turn on the system, and retry the operation.

messages: Invalid folder name or USB drive not found.
records.explanation: Operation failed because the folder name entered is incorrect or the USB drive is disconnected.
records.cause: Operation failed because the folder name entered is incorrect or the USB drive is disconnected.
records.recommended_action: Enter a valid folder name or attach the USB drive and retry the operation.

messages: Insufficient space to copy the file to the USB drive.
records.explanation: The USB drive does not have sufficient free space to copy the file.
records.recommended_action: Make sure the USB drive has sufficient free space before retrying the operation.

messages: Unable to write to the USB drive.
records.explanation: The USB drive is write protected.
records.recommended_action: Remove write protection on the USB drive before retrying the operation.

messages: Unable to copy the file to USB drive.
records.explanation: The USB drive is disconnected or is not readable.
records.recommended_action:
Remove and reinsert the USB drive and retry the operation. If the problem persists, restart the system
and retry.

messages: iDRAC not responding.
records.explanation: iDRAC has encountered a hardware error.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the operation. If the problem persists, 1) Turn off the system and disconnect the power cord. 2)
Wait five seconds. 3) Reconnect the power cord, turn on the system, and retry the operation.

messages: iDRAC communication failure.
records.explanation: Lifecycle Controller is unable to communicate with iDRAC.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the operation. If the problem persists, 1) Turn off the system and disconnect the power cord. 2)
Wait five seconds. 3) Reconnect the power cord, turn on the system, and retry the operation.

messages: The USB cable is absent.
records.explanation: The USB cable may be necessary for proper operation. System functionality may be degraded.
records.recommended_action: If removal was unintended, check presence, then re-install or reconnect.

messages: The mezzanine card arg1 is absent.
records.explanation: The mezzanine card may be necessary for proper operation. System functionality may be degraded.
records.recommended_action: If removal was unintended, check presence, then re-install or reconnect.

messages: The arg1 installed in slot arg2 is not supported by the chassis.
records.explanation: The peripheral sled identified in the message that is inserted in the slot identified in the message is not supported by the chassis or the current CMC/MM firmware version.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that the peripheral sled identified in the message is supported by the chassis and the
CMC/MM. For information about the supported sleds and firmware versions, see the System Manual
available at the support site.

messages: The compute sled in arg1 had shared storage mappings and has been replaced by a sled which cannot support shared mappings.
records.explanation: The compute sled in the specified slot has shared storage mappings which the storage controller in the new sled does not support. The current sled will not be powered on until further action is taken.
records.recommended_action:
Replace the specified sled with one whos storage controller supports shared mapping or clear the
mappings as appropriate.

messages: The peripheral sled in the slot arg1 has an internal cable disconnected or is missing required expanders.
records.explanation: One or more cables in the peripheral sled are not correctly connected or required expanders are not installed which can cause loss of functionality.
records.recommended_action: Remove the peripheral sled and check internal cables and required expanders are properly installed.

messages: The arg1 cable or interconnect is not connected or is improperly connected.
records.explanation: The cable may be necessary for proper operation. System functionality may be degraded.
records.recommended_action: Check presence, then re-install or reconnect.

messages: The storage arg1 cable is not connected, or is improperly connected.
records.explanation: The cable may be necessary for proper operation. System functionality may be degraded.
records.recommended_action: Check presence, then re-install or reconnect.

messages: The system board arg1 cable or interconnect is not connected, or is improperly connected.
records.explanation: The cable may be necessary for proper operation. System functionality may be degraded.
records.recommended_action: Check presence, then re-install or reconnect.

messages: The riser board cable or interconnect is not connected, or is improperly connected.
records.explanation: The riser blade cable may be necessary for proper operation. System functionality may be degraded.
records.recommended_action: Check presence, then re-install or reconnect.

messages: A fabric mismatch is detected between the server in slot arg1 and IO Module in slot arg2.
records.explanation: A fabric type mismatch is detected between the server in slot and I/O module as identified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
Check the chassis fabric type by using the Manage Module graphic user interface (GUI) and compare
against the type of fabric used in the I/O or mezzanine card. To check chassis type on the Manage
Module home page, select the server, and then view the I/O module properties. For more information
about the compatible fabric types, see the Manage Module Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: A fabric mismatch is detected between the server in slot arg1 and IO Module in slot arg2.
records.explanation: A fabric type mismatch is detected between the server in slot and I/O module as identified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
Check the chassis fabric type by using the Manage Module graphic user interface (GUI) and compare
against the type of fabric used in the I/O or mezzanine card. To check chassis type on the Manage
Module home page, select the server, and then view the I/O module properties. For more information
about the compatible fabric types, see the Manage Module Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: A fabric mismatch is detected between the server in slot arg1 and IO Module in slot arg2.
records.explanation: A fabric type mismatch is detected between the server in slot and I/O module as identified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
Check the chassis fabric type by using the Manage Module graphic user interface (GUI) and compare
against the type of fabric used in the I/O or mezzanine card. To check chassis type on the Manage
Module home page, select the server, and then view the I/O module properties. For more information
about the compatible fabric types, see the Manage Module Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: The Coin Cell battery in the front panel is not working.
records.explanation: The Coin Cell battery in the front panel is not working.
records.recommended_action:
Replace the Coin Cell battery. For more information about replacing, see the Management Module
Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: The arg1 control panel is not installed, or the cable is not connected to the Manage Module.
records.explanation: The control panel identified in the message is not installed, or the cable is not connected to the Manage Module.
records.recommended_action: Turn off the chassis and check if the control panel identified in the message is properly installed.

messages: A hardware incompatibility detected between BMC/iDRAC firmware and CPU.
records.explanation: A hardware incompatibility was detected between BMC/iDRAC firmware and Processor(s). An iDRAC or BMC firmware update is needed.
records.recommended_action:
Update the BMC/iDRAC firmware. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: A hardware incompatibility detected between BMC/iDRAC firmware and other hardware.
records.explanation: A hardware incompatibility was detected between BMC/iDRAC firmware and other hardware. An iDRAC or BMC firmware update is needed.
records.recommended_action:
Update the BMC/iDRAC firmware. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Hardware unsuccessfully updated for mezzanine card arg1.
records.explanation: No detailed description available.
records.recommended_action:
Check presence, re-install or reconnect, then re-attempt the update. If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: Hardware unsuccessfully updated for embedded NIC.
records.explanation: No detailed description available.
records.recommended_action:
Check presence, re-install or reconnect, then re-attempt the update. If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: Link Tuning error detected.
records.explanation: CMC/MM has old firmware and does not recognize the new device which has requested link tuning information. After updating the firmware the CMC/MM will recognize the device.
records.recommended_action:
Update the CMC/MM firmware. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report
using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the
Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Hardware incompatibility detected with mezzanine card arg1.
records.explanation: The system has detected a mezzanine card that is not supported on this system.
records.recommended_action:
1) Review system documentation for supported mezzanine cards. 2) Replace mezzanine card with a
supported mezzanine card.

messages: Unable to control the fan speed because a sled mismatch or hardware incompatibility is detected.
records.explanation: The fan speed cannot be controlled because a sled mismatch or hardware incompatibility is detected. This results in fans rotating at the maximum allowed speed (RPM).
records.cause: The fan speed cannot be controlled because a sled mismatch or hardware incompatibility is detected. This results in fans rotating at the maximum allowed speed (RPM).
records.recommended_action:
Remove the sled in which a hardware incompatibility is detected and replace with a compatible
working sled. For more information about hardware compatibility, see the platform Owners Manual
available on the support site.

messages: A fabric mismatch detected on arg1.
records.explanation: The fabric type for the IOM and mezzanine cards must match. Once an IOM or mezzanine card is inserted into the chassis, the fabric type is then set for the CMC/MM and the CMC/MM will ensure that all subsequent IOMs and mezzanine cards match.
records.recommended_action: Check chassis fabric type in CMC/MM GUI and compare to the type of IOM or mezzanine card.

messages: A link tuning failure detected on arg1.
records.explanation: CMC/MM has old firmware and does not recognize the new device which has requested link tuning information. After updating the firmware the CMC/MM will recognize the device.
records.recommended_action:
Update the CMC/MM firmware. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report
using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the
Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: IO module arg1 is offline.
records.explanation: The CMC/MM has powered off the IOM identified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://
www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze
the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: An over-temperature event detected on I/O module arg1.
records.explanation: The I/O module over heated.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following: 1) Make sure fans are installed and working correctly. 2) Check the temperature
sensor status for the chassis and make sure it is within the chassis operating temperature range.
3) Reseat the I/O module to clear the over-temperature condition. If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: A failure is detected on IO module arg1.
records.explanation: The IOM module performance may be impact.
records.recommended_action:
If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://
www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze
the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: I/O module arg1 failed to boot.
records.explanation: The firmware on the I/O module did not boot. The problem may be because the I/O module is not inserted correctly.
records.cause: The firmware on the I/O module did not boot. The problem may be because the I/O module is not inserted correctly.
records.recommended_action:
Reseat I/O module. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC.
Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant
to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: The CMC/MM is unable to turn on the I/O module arg1.
records.explanation: The I/O module identified in the message cannot be turned on by the CMC/MM.
records.recommended_action:
Do one of the following: 1) Perform a Powercycle operation on the I/O module identified in the
message. A Powercycle operation can be performed using the RACADM command line utility by typing
"racadm chassisaction -m switch-N powercycle (where N is the switch number)". 2) Reseat the
I/O module identified in the message. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: An invalid cable or incorrect cable configuration is detected.
records.explanation: An invalid cable related hardware configuration detected on the system.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure the hardware and related cables are installed correctly. For information about configuration
and installation procedures, see the systems Owners Manual available at the support site.

messages: Unable to perform controller firmware update on IO Module in slot arg1.
records.explanation: Unable to perform controller firmware update on IO Module identified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
Reseat the IO Module and retry the operation. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection
(TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic
to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: The configuration information of the IO Module in slot arg1 does not match its peer IOM Module configuration information.
records.explanation: The IO Module in the slot specifieds configuration data and that of its peer is inconsistent. This inconsistency cannot be automatically resolved.
records.recommended_action: Clear both IO Modules configuration and reconfigure them.

messages: Unable to fully complete the update operation of the Controller firmware because the IO Module in slot arg1 is turned on.
records.explanation: The update operation of the Controller firmware version cannot be fully completed because the IO Module in slot identified in the message is powered on. IO Module must be virtually reseated to make the update operation fully effective.
records.cause: The update operation of the Controller firmware version cannot be fully completed because the IO Module in slot identified in the message is powered on. IO Module must be virtually reseated to make the update operation fully effective.
records.recommended_action:
Perform a Virtual Reseat operation on the IO module to complete the controller firmware update. To
reseat by using the Management Modules Graphical User Interface (GUI), on the IO Modules page,
click Power Actions > System Reseat.

messages: Unable to process the I/O Module request because of an internal system error.
records.explanation: The I/O Module request cannot be processed because of an internal system error.
records.recommended_action: Retry the operation. If the issue persists, contact your service provider.

messages: The I/O Module in slot arg1 cannot process the request because an invalid parameter is entered.
records.explanation: The request cannot be processed by the I/O module in the slot identified in the message because of an internal system error.
records.recommended_action:
Enter a valid parameter and retry the operation. If the issue persists, contact your service provider.
For information about valid parameters, see the OpenManage Enterprise-Modular Users Guide
available on the support site.

messages: The request cannot be processed by the I/O Module in slot arg1 because the necessary service is not running.
records.explanation: The request cannot be processed by the I/O Module in the slot identified in the message because the necessary service is not running.
records.cause: The request cannot be processed by the I/O Module in the slot identified in the message because the necessary service is not running.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the operation. If the issue persists, contact your service provider. For more information, see the
OpenManage Enterprise-Modular Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: The request cannot be processed by the I/O Module in slot arg1 because the I/O Module is busy in processing other requests.
records.explanation: The request cannot be processed by the I/O Module in slot identified in the message because the I/O Module is busy in processing other requests.
records.cause: The request cannot be processed by the I/O Module in slot identified in the message because the I/O Module is busy in processing other requests.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the operation. If the issue persists, contact your service provider. For more information, see the
OpenManage Enterprise-Modular Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: System critical event has occurred in the IO Module in slot arg1. The following fault message was logged by the IOM: arg2.
records.explanation: System critical event has occurred in the IO Module identified in the message.
records.recommended_action: See detailed description for recommended action.

messages: System warning event has occurred in the IO Module in slot arg1. The following fault message was logged by the IOM: arg2.
records.explanation: System warning event has occurred in the IO Module identified in the message.
records.recommended_action: See detailed description for recommended action.

messages: The SD card device sensor has failed. SD card location: arg1, SD card device type: arg2, SD card state: arg3.
records.explanation: The SD card device sensor of the type identified in the message has failed. The current status of the SD card is also displayed.
records.recommended_action:
Reinsert the SD card or try a different SD card and retry the operation. If the issue persists, do one
of the following to resolve the error: 1) If the SD card sensor is installed on the internal SD module,
replace the module. 2) If the SD card sensor is embedded on the system board, replace the system
board. . For more information, contact your service provider.

messages: The SD card has failed. SD card location: arg1, SD card device type: arg2, SD card state: arg3.
records.explanation: The SD card sensor detected an SD card failure.
records.recommended_action: Replace the old SD card with a new SD card.

messages: The SD card has failed. SD card location: arg1, SD card device type: arg2, SD card state: arg3.
records.explanation: An SD card device sensor has detected an irrecoverable error in the SD card.
records.recommended_action: Replace the old SD card with a new SD card.

messages: The health of the SDPM is affected by a critical cable issue.
records.explanation: The health of the SDPM is affected by a critical cable issue. Subsequent persistent memory save operations will fail.
records.recommended_action:
Refer to the platform documentation for details related to SDPM subsystem. Copy any data in the
persistent memory to another persistent device such as a hard drive. Power off the system and
remove input power. Inspect and re-insert all the SDPM power and data cables.

messages: A thermally unsupported arg1 configuration is detected.
records.explanation: A thermally unsupported configuration is detected in the component identified in the message. Fan speeds may increase to protect the system.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following and retry the operation: 1) Review the ID HWC8022 message in the Lifecycle
Log for more information about the unsupported configuration. 2) Resolve the unsupported
configuration or revert to any recent system configuration changes. 3) If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: The validated Configuration Check result indicates that the cable connecting arg1 and arg2 must be removed.
records.explanation: The validated Configuration Check result indicates that the cable indicated in the message must be removed for proper functioning of the server.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following: 1) Disconnect the input power. 2) Remove the cable indicated in the message. 3) If
the issue persists, retry the operation.

messages: The validated Configuration Check result indicates that the cable connecting arg1 and arg2 must be installed.
records.explanation: The validated Configuration Check result indicates that the cable indicated in the message must be installed for proper functioning of the server.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following: 1) Disconnect the input power. 2) Install the cable indicated in the message. 3) If the
issue persists, retry the operation.

messages: Unable to complete the operation because of an issue with the I/O panel cable.
records.explanation: The operation could not successfully completed because of an issue with the I/O panel cable.
records.cause: The operation could not successfully completed because of an issue with the I/O panel cable.
records.recommended_action:
Do one of the following and retry the operation: 1) Connect the I/O panel cable properly 2) Replace
the I/O panel cable.

messages: Unable to synchronize control panel firmware due to internal error.
records.explanation: During a Chassis Management Controller (CMC) firmware update, the control panel firmware synchronization failed. The control panel may be inoperable.
records.recommended_action:
Remove and reapply chassis input power. If problem persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: One or more PCIe switch heatsinks are not properly attached.
records.explanation: The heatsinks are critical for providing cooling to the PCIe switches. If a PCIe switch stops functioning due to improper cooling, the PCIe subsystem may no longer function correctly and data loss may occur.
records.recommended_action:
Immediately turn off the Chassis by pressing the Chassis power button or removing chassis input
power. The Chassis can be turned off remotely by running the following RACADM command "racadm
chassisaction -m chassis nongraceshutdown". After turning off, Collect a SupportAssist collection
(TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic
to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: The arg1 device may not function as expected because the device health status turned to Warning.
records.explanation: The BOSS device identified in the message may not function because either the inlet temperature, fan health, or total power associated with the BOSS device is reaching the threshold value.
records.cause: The BOSS device identified in the message may not function because either the inlet temperature, fan health, or total power associated with the BOSS device is reaching the threshold value.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that the inlet temperature, fan health, or total power associated with the BOSS device is
within specified limits. For information about specified values, see the iDRAC 9.0 and later Users Guide
available on the support site.

messages: The arg1 device may not function as expected because the device health status turned to Critical.
records.explanation: The BOSS device identified in the message may not function because either the inlet temperature, fan health properties, or total power associated with the BOSS device has exceeded the threshold values.
records.cause: The BOSS device identified in the message may not function because either the inlet temperature, fan health properties, or total power associated with the BOSS device has exceeded the threshold values.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that the inlet temperature, fan health, or total power associated with the BOSS device are
within specified limits. For information about specified values, see the iDRAC 9.0 and later Users Guide
available on the support site.

messages: The server board arg1 cable or the server interconnect is not available.
records.explanation: The server board cable or the server interconnect may be necessary for proper operation. System functionality may be degraded.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that the server board cable and interconnect is available and properly connected. For
more information about connecting, see the Installation and Service Manual of the respective server
available on the support site.

messages: A communication error is observed either in the server board arg1 cable or the server interconnect.
records.explanation: A communication error is observed either in the server board cable identified in the message or the server interconnect.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that the server board cable and interconnect is available and properly connected. For
more information about connecting, see the Installation and Service Manual of the respective server
available on the support site.

messages: A message is logged by the arg1 operating system. Message: arg2.
records.explanation: A message is logged by the DPU operating system identified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following to resolve the issue: 1) Verify the DPU operating system log. 2) Restart the DPU.
If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://
www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze
the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: A message is logged by the arg1 operating system. Message: arg2.
records.explanation: A message is logged by the DPU operating system identified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following to resolve the issue: 1) Verify the DPU operating system log. 2) Restart the DPU.
If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://
www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze
the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: The health of Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) device arg1 is critical because of single or double bit errors on the memory cells.
records.explanation: The health of Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) device identified in the message is degraded. There are a few memory pages retired on the device because of a Double Bit Error (DBE) or two consecutive Single Bit Errors (SBEs) on the memory cell. The memory pages are retired to avoid any runtime corruption of data.
records.cause: The health of Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) device identified in the message is degraded. There are a few memory pages retired on the device because of a Double Bit Error (DBE) or two consecutive Single Bit Errors (SBEs) on the memory cell. The memory pages are retired to avoid any runtime corruption of data.
records.recommended_action:
If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://
www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze
the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: A mismatch of GPU models is detected on the server which might result in suboptimal performance.
records.explanation: A mismatch of GPU models is detected on the server which might result in suboptimal performance.
records.recommended_action: Ensure that all the GPUs installed on the server are of same model.

messages: Unable to create or allocate the required resources.
records.explanation: CMC could not successfully allocate resources because of the following reasons: 1) The chassis manager is unable to allocate required resources. 2) The chassis manager or chassis infrastructure firmware is rolled back to an earlier version. 3) There is an issue with the internal communications between chassis components.
records.cause: CMC could not successfully allocate resources because of the following reasons: 1) The chassis manager is unable to allocate required resources. 2) The chassis manager or chassis infrastructure firmware is rolled back to an earlier version. 3) There is an issue with the internal communications between chassis components.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure the firmware for the various chassis components are compatible with each other. If this
is the case, do the following: 1) Turn off the chassis, by pressing the chassis Power Button, 2) run
the following CMC RACADM command "racadm racresetcfg". If the problem persists, contact your
technical service provider.

messages: Unable to manage the device located in the PCIe slot specified in the operation.
records.explanation: A PCIe device error was detected that does not allow the assignment, unassignment, or the turning off of the device. The errors can be caused by incorrect PCIe device installation or installation of an unsupported PCIe adapter card. For a list of supported PCIe adapter cards contact your service provider.
records.cause: A PCIe device error was detected that does not allow the assignment, unassignment, or the turning off of the device. The errors can be caused by incorrect PCIe device installation or installation of an unsupported PCIe adapter card. For a list of supported PCIe adapter cards contact your service provider.
records.recommended_action: Make sure that supported adapters are used and installed correctly in the PCIe slots.

messages: Unable to turn on PCIe adapter.
records.explanation: The chassis manager is unable to turn on the PCIe device because of one of the following reasons: 1) PCIe device is not supported, 2) The device is not properly inserted in the slot, 3) The device is not functioning properly, or 4) The device power requirements exceed the power available for the slot.
records.cause: The chassis manager is unable to turn on the PCIe device because of one of the following reasons: 1) PCIe device is not supported, 2) The device is not properly inserted in the slot, 3) The device is not functioning properly, or 4) The device power requirements exceed the power available for the slot.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure a supported PCIe device is used and that it is properly inserted in the PCIe slot. For a list of
supported devices, contact the service provider.

messages: Unable to map/un-map or turn on the external shared adapter because the firmware version of Chassis Management Controller (CMC) Chassis Infrastructure Mainboard is not the latest version supporting the adapter.
