report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Microcode update on arg1 has failed.
records.explanation: The attempt to update the physical disk has failed. This is due to too much activity on the bus, a bad update package, or a bad disk.
records.cause: The attempt to update the physical disk has failed. This is due to too much activity on the bus, a bad update package, or a bad disk.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the update. If the update fails a second time, verify the update package is valid. If the update
package is valid, replace the failing disk. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Command timeout occurred on arg1.arg2.
records.explanation: An error occurred while performing an action on the disk.
records.recommended_action: Check the disk is present or replace the disk.

messages: The value of arg1 is greater than the upper critical threshold.
records.explanation: The utilization value of the sensor identified in the message is higher than the upper critical threshold.
records.recommended_action:
Check the work load of the server and reduce the workload if necessary to bring the system
performance into required ranges. For more information about the specified values, see the relevant
product documentation available at the support site.

messages: The value of arg1 is greater than the upper warning threshold.
records.explanation: The utilization value of the sensor identified in the message is higher than the upper warning threshold.
records.recommended_action:
Check the work load of the server and reduce the workload if necessary to bring the system
performance into required ranges. For more information about the specified values, see the relevant
product documentation available at the support site.

messages: Power on permission error, chassis infrastructure not ready.
records.explanation: Host failed to power up because chassis infrastructure is not ready. This messages has been replaced by Message ID PWR2250.
records.cause: Host failed to power up because chassis infrastructure is not ready. This messages has been replaced by Message ID PWR2250.
records.recommended_action: Check status of chassis infrastructure.

messages: Power on permission error, chassis cover open.
records.explanation: Host failed to power up because chassis cover is open. This messages has been replaced by Message ID PWR2251.
records.cause: Host failed to power up because chassis cover is open. This messages has been replaced by Message ID PWR2251.
records.recommended_action: Check chassis cover.

messages: Power on permission error, CMC is in MPCM mode.
records.explanation: Host failed to power up because CMC MPCM mode is enabled. This messages has been replaced by Message ID PWR2255.
records.cause: Host failed to power up because CMC MPCM mode is enabled. This messages has been replaced by
records.recommended_action: Disable MPCM mode to power up.

messages: Some of the configuration values stored for the previous device could not be applied to device: arg1
records.explanation: Some of the configuration values stored for the previous device could not be applied to the current device. This may be due to firmware version or other differences in the part.
records.cause: Some of the configuration values stored for the previous device could not be applied to the current device. This may be due to firmware version or other differences in the part.
records.recommended_action: Check the devices configuration and ensure that the new configuration is correct for the system.

messages: Missing or corrupt configuration database.
records.explanation: The systems configuration database is missing or is unreadable. This may be due to a user action such as Lifecycle Controller Wipe or a replaced motherboard.
records.cause: The systems configuration database is missing or is unreadable. This may be due to a user action such as Lifecycle Controller Wipe or a replaced motherboard.
records.recommended_action:
Enable the Collect System Inventory on Restart attribute of the Lifecycle Controller and restart the
system. Alternatively, use the Unified Server Configurator utility.

messages: The Storage Controller is successfully installed. However, controller security settings are not automatically restored after replacing the Storage Controller.
records.explanation: The Storage Controller is successfully installed. However, controller security settings are not automatically restored after replacing the Storage Controller.
records.recommended_action:
Enable the security feature on the replaced card using any of the iDRAC interfaces. To enable by using
iDRAC GUI, click Actions > Edit > Security option in Storage > Controllers. To enable by using CLI,
run the following RACADM command: racadm storage setencryptionmode: -mode SEKM. For more
information, see the latest version of the iDRAC Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: The configuration values stored for the previous device could not be applied to device: arg1
records.explanation: Some or all configuration values stored for the previous device could not be applied to the current device. This may be due to firmware version or other differences in the part.
records.cause: Some or all configuration values stored for the previous device could not be applied to the current device. This may be due to firmware version or other differences in the part.
records.recommended_action: Check the devices configuration and ensure that the new configuration is correct for the system.

messages: An issue was detected. System at boot F1/F2 prompt. Requires entry to continue.
records.explanation: System is at the F1/F2 prompt because the system BIOS detected an issue other than "No bootable devices".
records.cause: System is at the F1/F2 prompt because the system BIOS detected an issue other than "No bootable devices".
records.recommended_action: Check post display screen for details. Press F1 to continue boot, or press F2 to go to setup.

messages: No bootable devices.
records.explanation: System is at F1/F2 prompt because the system BIOS was unable to detect a bootable device.
records.cause: System is at F1/F2 prompt because the system BIOS was unable to detect a bootable device.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure a bootable device is attached to the system and enabled in BIOS setup. If device
is attached and enabled, remove and reapply power to server. If the issue persists, Collect a
SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: No memory is detected.
records.explanation: System BIOS was unable to detect memory in the system . This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video (BIOS Post Exception 80).
records.recommended_action: Inspect System Memory.

messages: Memory is detected, but is not configurable.
records.explanation: System BIOS detected memory, but was unable to configure the memory for system operation. Compare system memory installation to supported system memory configurations. Reduce the system to minimum memory configuration if acceptable. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video.(BIOS POST Exception Code 81).
records.recommended_action: Compare system memory installation to supported system memory configurations.

messages: Memory is configured, but not usable.
records.explanation: During memory configuration system BIOS encountered device failures or speed configurations that resulted in unused memory. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video. (BIOS POST Exception code 82).
records.recommended_action:
Remove input power. Reseat memory devices or reduce system to minimum supported memory
configuration.

messages: System BIOS shadow failed.
records.explanation: Memory errors occurred copying BIOS image into system memory. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video. (BIOS POST Exception Code 83).
records.recommended_action: Remove input power. Reduce system memory to minimum configuration and apply input power.

messages: CMOS failed.
records.explanation: System BIOS detected a failure with CMOS memory during system POST. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video. (BIOS POST Exception Code 84).
records.recommended_action:
Check system event log for CMOS battery exceptions. Remove and reapply input power. If the issue
persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/
support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and
recommend a resolution.

messages: DMA controller failed.
records.explanation: System BIOS detected a failure with the DMA controller during system POST. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video. (BIOS POST Exception code 85).
records.recommended_action: Remove and reapply input power.

messages: Interrupt controller failed.
records.explanation: System BIOS detected a failure with the interrupt controller during system POST. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video. (BIOS POST Exception code 86).
records.recommended_action:
Remove and reapply input power. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Timer refresh failed.
records.explanation: System BIOS detected a timer refresh failure during system POST. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video. (BIOS POST Exception code 87).
records.recommended_action:
Remove and reapply input power. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Programmable interval timer error.
records.explanation: System BIOS detected an failure with the programmable interval timer during POST. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video. (BIOS POST Exception code 88).
records.recommended_action:
Remove and reapply input power. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Parity error.
records.explanation: System BIOS detected a parity error during post This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video. (BIOS POST exception code 89).
records.recommended_action:
Remove and reapply input power. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: SuperIO failed.
records.explanation: System BIOS detected a failure with the SIO. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video. (BIOS POST code exception code 8A).
records.recommended_action:
Remove and reapply input power. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Keyboard controller failed.
records.explanation: System BIOS detected a failure with the Keyboard Controller. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video. (BIOS POST exception code 8B).
records.recommended_action:
Remove and reapply input power. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: QuickPath Interconnect (QPI) fatal error.
records.explanation: Quick Path Interconnect failed during system POST. Reboot the system. If problem persists, remove input power and reseat processors. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video.
records.recommended_action: Reboot the system. If problem persists, remove input power and reseat processors.

messages: MRC fatal error.
records.explanation: BIOS Memory testing failed. Compare system memory installation to supported system memory configurations. Reduce system configuration to minimum memory configuration. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video.
records.recommended_action:
Compare system memory installation to supported system memory configurations. Reduce system
configuration to minimum memory configuration.

messages: Intel Trusted Execution Technology (TXT) fatal error.
records.explanation: TXT boot failed. This could be related to memory errors or an error with the system TXT configuration. A socketed TPM module may have been removed. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video.
records.cause: TXT boot failed. This could be related to memory errors or an error with the system TXT configuration. A socketed TPM module may have been removed. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video.
records.recommended_action:
Check TPM presence. Remove and reapply input power. If the issue persists, Collect a
SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: Unable to load required BIOS files.
records.explanation: System BIOS is unable to load the required BIOS files.
records.recommended_action:
Remove and reapply input power. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Shut-down test failed.
records.explanation: System BIOS shutdown test failed during POST. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video. (BIOS POST exception code C0).
records.recommended_action:
Check system event log for CMOS battery exceptions. Remove and reapply input power. If the issue
persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/
support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and
recommend a resolution.

messages: BIOS POST memory test failed.
records.explanation: System BIOS POST memory test failed. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video. (BIOS POST exception code C1).
records.recommended_action:
Compare system memory installation to supported system memory configurations. Reduce system
configuration to minimum memory configuration.

messages: Remote access controller configuration failed.
records.explanation: System BIOS could not configure the Remote Access controller This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video. (BIOS POST exception code C2).
records.recommended_action:
Power cycle the system. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using
iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual
Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: CPU configuration failed.
records.explanation: The current processor configuration is unsupported or encountered a fatal exception during POST. Check the processor configuration. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video. (BIOS POST exception code C3).
records.recommended_action: Review system processor configuration and reduce the system to the minimum configuration.

messages: Incorrect memory configuration.
records.explanation: System BIOS detected an invalid memory population. Reinstall the memory to match the supported population. This exception occurred early in system power on, thus the system may not display video. (BIOS POST Exception code C4).
records.recommended_action: Re-install memory to match supported memory configuration.

messages: System BIOS has halted due to Non-Maskable Interrupt (NMI).
records.explanation: System BIOS has halted and is unable to continue. System BIOS has detected a Non-Maskable Interrupt (NMI) which may have been caused by a hardware change.
records.cause: System BIOS has halted and is unable to continue. System BIOS has detected a Non-Maskable Interrupt (NMI) which may have been caused by a hardware change.
records.recommended_action:
Do one of the following: 1) If new hardware has been added, remove the new hardware and restart
the server, 2) Turn server off and back on using the power button, or 3) Remove and reapply server
input power. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit
https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to
analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: A high-severity issue has occurred at the Power-On Self-Test (POST) phase which has resulted in the system BIOS to abruptly stop functioning.
records.explanation: A high-severity issue has occurred at the Power-On Self-Test (POST) phase which has resulted in the system BIOS to abruptly stop functioning. BIOS is unable to report the issue on the POST screen.
records.recommended_action:
Power cycle the system. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using
iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual
Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: POST fatal error detected.
records.explanation: System BIOS detected a functional or configuration issue during system POST. Check the system video screen for more information. The system event log may contain additional details.
records.recommended_action: Check system video and review event log for additional information.

messages: The AMD Platform Security Processor (PSP) detected an issue during platform initialization.
records.explanation: The AMD Platform Security Processor (PSP) detected an issue during platform initialization.
records.recommended_action:
Do one of the following: 1) Power off the server, then power on by using the power
button. 2) Disconnect the input power, and then reconnect. If the issue persists, Collect a
SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: The AMD Platform Security Processor (PSP) detected a security-related issue while booting the server.
records.explanation: The AMD Platform Security Processor (PSP) detected a security-related issue while booting the server and paused the server from further booting.
records.recommended_action:
Do one of the following: 1) Power off the server, then power on by using the power
button. 2) Disconnect the input power, and then reconnect. If the issue persists, Collect a
SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: Power supply arg1 failed.
records.explanation: No detailed description available.
records.recommended_action:
Remove and re-install the power supply. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: A predictive failure detected on power supply arg1.
records.explanation: System performance and power redundancy may be degraded or lost.
records.recommended_action:
Remove and re-install the power supply at the next service window. If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: The Power Supply Unit (PSU) arg1 is not receiving input power because of issues in PSU or cable connections.
records.explanation: The power supply is installed correctly but an input source is not connected or is not functional.
records.cause: The Power Supply Unit (PSU) arg1 is not receiving input power because of issues in PSU or cable connections.
records.recommended_action:
Ensure that the following is correct: 1) Input power source is connected to the PSU. 2) Power is
within the operating requirements of PSU. 3) Cables are properly connected. If the issue persists,
manually reseat and/or swap the PSUs.

messages: The power input for power supply arg1 is outside of the allowable range, but it is attached to the system.
records.explanation: The operating requirements for the power supply may be found in product documentation or on the power supply itself.
records.recommended_action: Verify the input power is within the operating requirements for the power supply.

messages: Power supply arg1 is incorrectly configured.
records.explanation: The power supply identified in the message must be supported by the platform. Generally, multiple power supplies in the server should have the same feature set and power rating.
records.recommended_action: Review server product documentation for supported power supplies and power supply configurations.

messages: The temperature for power supply arg1 is in a warning range.
records.explanation: System performance may be degraded.
records.recommended_action:
Check the system operating environment, including airflow and inlet temperature. Check system logs
for temperature and thermal component failures.

messages: The temperature for power supply arg1 is outside of range.
records.explanation: System performance may be degraded.
records.recommended_action:
Check the system operating environment, including airflow and inlet temperature. Check system logs
for temperature and thermal component failures.

messages: An under voltage fault detected on power supply arg1.
records.explanation: This failure may be the result of an electrical issue with cables or subsystem components in the system.
records.cause: This failure may be the result of an electrical issue with cables or subsystem components in the system.
records.recommended_action:
1) Remove and re-install the power supply. 2) Check cables and subsystem components in the system
for damage. 3) If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC.
Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant
to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: An over voltage fault detected on power supply arg1.
records.explanation: No detailed description available.
records.recommended_action:
Check input power, replace or re-install the power supply. If the issue persists, Collect a
SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: An over current fault detected on power supply arg1.
records.explanation: This failure may be the result of an electrical issue with cables or subsystem components in the system.
records.cause: This failure may be the result of an electrical issue with cables or subsystem components in the system.
records.recommended_action:
1) Remove and re-install the power supply. 2) Check cables and subsystem components in the system
for damage. 3) If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC.
Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant
to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Fan failure detected on power supply arg1.
records.explanation: No detailed description available.
records.recommended_action: Check for fan blockage. If not replace the power supply.

messages: An under current fault detected on power supply arg1.
records.explanation: Insufficient amount of current to keep power supply operating at a normal levels.
records.recommended_action:
1) Remove and re-install the power supply input cord. 2) Check power distribution or PSU input source
for anomalies. 3) If the issue persists,Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC.
Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant
to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: An output under voltage fault detected on power supply arg1.
records.explanation: The power supply output voltage is insufficient to keep system operating at a normal levels.
records.recommended_action:
1) Remove the power supply input cord and then remove power supply. 2) Re-install the power supply
and then re-install the power supply cord. 3) If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection
(TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic
to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: An output over voltage fault detected on power supply arg1.
records.explanation: No detailed description available.
records.recommended_action:
1) Remove the power supply input cord and then remove power supply. 2) Re-install the power supply
and then re-install the power supply cord. 3) If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection
(TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic
to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: An output over current fault detected on power supply arg1.
records.explanation: No detailed description available.
records.recommended_action:
1) Remove the power supply input cord and then remove power supply. 2) Re-install the power supply
and then re-install the power supply cord. 3) If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection
(TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic
to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: An output under current fault detected on power supply arg1.
records.explanation: No detailed description available.
records.recommended_action:
1) Remove the power supply input cord and then remove power supply. 2) Re-install the power supply
and then re-install the power supply cord. 3) If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection
(TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic
to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Cannot obtain status information from power supply arg1.
records.explanation: The power supply is operating but the system cannot get status information.
records.recommended_action: If problem persist, remove and re-install power supply.

messages: A communication error is observed between the primary and secondary Digital Signal Processors (DSPs) of Power Supply Unit (PSU) arg1.
records.explanation: A communication error is observed between the primary and secondary Digital Signal Processors (DSPs) of Power Supply Unit (PSU) identified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
1) Remove the power supply input cord, and then remove the Power Supply Unit (PSU). 2) Reinstall
the PSU and reconnect the cord. 3) If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Unable to power on the Power Supply Unit (PSU) arg1 within four seconds after the PSU is enabled.
records.explanation: The Power Supply Unit (PSU) identified in the message cannot be powered on within four seconds after the PSU is enabled.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following and retry the operation. 1) Remove the power supply input cord, and then remove
the Power Supply Unit (PSU). 2) Reinstall the PSU and reconnect the cord. 3) If the issue
persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/
support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and
recommend a resolution.

messages: Power Supply Units (PSUs) are not installed in Chassis Zone-2.
records.explanation: Power Supply Units (PSUs) are not installed in Chassis Zone-2.
records.recommended_action:
Ensure that Chassis Zone-2 has at least one PSU installed. If there is already a PSU installed in
Zone-2, remove and re-insert it. Ensure that the LED status is green. It the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: Power Supply Units (PSUs) are not installed in Chassis Zone-1.
records.explanation: Power Supply Units (PSUs) are not installed in Chassis Zone-1.
records.recommended_action:
Ensure that Chassis Zone-1 has at least one PSU installed. If there is already a PSU installed in
Zone-1, remove and re-insert it. Ensure that the LED status is green. It the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: A power supply wattage mismatch is detected; power supply arg1 is rated for arg2 watts.
records.explanation: Power supplies should be of the same input type and power rating.
records.recommended_action: Install matched power supplies and review product documentation for proper configuration.

messages: Power supply arg1 revision mismatch detected.
records.explanation: This power supply revision is not supported for this system.
records.recommended_action: Review product documentation, change power supply with correct revision.

messages: Power supply arg1 voltage rating does not match the system requirements.
records.explanation: The system does not support mixed voltage power supplies.
records.recommended_action: Review product documentation, change power supply with correct voltage rating.

messages: Power supply unit arg1 rating exceeds the system power distribution limits.
records.explanation: The rating of the power supply unit identified in the message should not exceed system power distribution limits.
records.recommended_action:
Remove the power supply unit identified in the message and review server product documentation for
appropriate configuration.

messages: Could not power down 240VA on power unit arg1.
records.explanation: In order to meet service requirements the supply must be shut down.
records.recommended_action: Remove input power at the power supply.

messages: An interlock power down error detected on power unit arg1.
records.explanation: In order to meet service requirements the supply must be shut down.
records.recommended_action: Remove input power at the power supply.

messages: Power lost on power unit arg1.
records.explanation: The power supply is installed correctly but an input source is not connected or is not functional.
records.recommended_action:
Verify the input source is attached to the power supply. Verify the input power is within the operating
requirements for the power supply.

messages: Soft power control failure detected on power unit arg1.
records.explanation: The system did not respond correctly to a power down request.
records.recommended_action: Disconnect Input Power.

messages: A failure detected on power unit arg1.
records.explanation: Status from the power supply indicates a power supply exception occurred. The power supply will try to operate in a degraded state. System Performance and power redundancy may be degraded or lost.
records.recommended_action:
Check input power. Re-install the power supply. It the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection
(TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic
to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: A predictive failure detected on power unit arg1.
records.explanation: Status from the power supply indicates a power supply exception occurred. The power supply will try to operate. System Performance and power redundancy may be degraded or lost.
records.recommended_action: Remove input power and re-install supply at the next service window.

messages: The Power Supply Unit (PSU) arg1 firmware is not responding.
records.explanation: The Power Supply Unit (PSU) firmware of the PSU identified in the message is not responding. The firmware is corrupted and stuck in the bootloader operation.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following and retry the operation:1) Remove the Power Supply Unit (PSU) and reinstall.
2) Retry the PSU update operation. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: The server is unable to communicate with Power Supply arg1.
records.explanation: The server is unable to communicate with the Power Supply Unit (PSU) identified in the message. The PSU is supplying power to the server.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following and retry the operation: 1) Power down the server. 2) Remove Power Supply
Unit (PSU) and reinstall. 3) Reset the server by running RACADM command at the command
line interface(CLI), "racadm racreset" or at server GUI, "Reset IDRAC" under option:More Actions.
If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://
www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze
the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: The Power Supply Unit (PSU) in the slot arg1 is in the Bootloader mode and therefore does not support all functionalities. It is currently in the Bootloader mode because arg2.
records.explanation: The Power Supply Unit (PSU) in the slot identified in the message is in the Bootloader mode and therefore does not support all functionalities.
records.recommended_action:
Install or upgrade the PSU firmware to get all the functionalities. For information about upgrading the
PSU firmware, see the iDRAC Users Guide of the respective iDRAC version on the support site.

messages: Power supply arg1 is offline.
records.explanation: The power supply unit identified in the message is offline, because of the one of the following reasons: 1) The power supply unit is not correctly seated. 2) The power cable may not be connected properly or disconnected. 3) The power supply unit has failed. 4) There is an input power failure.
records.cause: The power supply unit identified in the message is offline, because of the one of the following reasons: 1) The power supply unit is not correctly seated. 2) The power cable may not be connected properly or disconnected. 3) The power supply unit has failed. 4) There is an input power failure.
records.recommended_action:
Do one of the following to resolve the issue: 1) reseat the power supply unit. 2) Reconnect the power
cable to the power supply unit. 3) Install a new power supply unit 4) Restore the input power supply.

messages: Power supply cable has been removed from arg1.
records.explanation: The power supply unit is not receiving input AC power. The power cable may not be connected properly or removed. This can happen if there is an AC failure or problems with the power strip attached to the enclosure power supply.
records.recommended_action:
Reconnect the power cable to the power supply unit if it was disconnected. Restore the input AC
power supply. Make sure the power supply is restored to the enclosure from the mains.

messages: arg1 has failed.
records.explanation: The enclosure detected that a power supply unit has failed.
records.recommended_action:
Check for other messages related to the state of the power supply unit/enclosure. These may help
determine the cause of this event. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: arg1 was removed
records.explanation: The enclosure detected that a power supply unit was removed and is no longer functioning in optimal condition.
records.recommended_action:
Re-insert the power supply unit into the enclosure. Re-connect the AC power cable and switch on the
power supply unit. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC.
Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant
to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: arg1 is switched OFF.
records.explanation: The power supply is not providing any power. This may be because the power supply switch is in the off position or the power supply has failed.
records.cause: The power supply is not providing any power. This may be because the power supply switch is in the off position or the power supply has failed.
records.recommended_action:
Check whether the power switch on the power supply unit is turned off or on. If it is turned off, turn
it on. If the problem is not corrected, verify that the power cord is attached and functional. See the
storage hardware documentation for more information.

messages: Power supply arg1 is not present.
records.explanation: The power supply unit identified in the message is not present, because of the one of the following reasons: 1) The power supply unit is not correctly seated. 2) The power cable may not be connected properly or disconnected. 3) The power supply unit has failed. 4) There is an input power failure.
records.cause: The power supply unit identified in the message is not present, because of the one of the following reasons: 1) The power supply unit is not correctly seated. 2) The power cable may not be connected properly or disconnected. 3) The power supply unit has failed. 4) There is an input power failure.
records.recommended_action:
Do one of the following to resolve the issue: 1) reseat the power supply unit. 2) Reconnect the power
cable to the power supply unit. 3) Install a new power supply unit 4) Restore the input power supply.

messages: The DC power supply is switched off.
records.explanation: The power supply unit is switched off. Either you have switched off the power supply unit or it is defective.
records.recommended_action:
Check to see whether the power switch is turned off or on. If it is turned off, turn it on. If the problem
is not corrected, verify that the power cord is attached and functional. If the problem continues or if
the power switch is already turned on, then replace the power supply unit.

messages: The PSU in slot arg1 detected 110 VAC input voltage and does not match chassis configuration.
records.explanation: The input voltage of the PSU specified in the message does not match the input voltage of the PSUs already present in the chassis.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following: 1) Check the power configuration "Allow 110 VAC Operation" setting and make sure
it is enabled. 2) Check if the input voltage of all the PSUs are the same. 3) If the input voltage of the
PSU specified in the message is not the same, then remove the unmatched PSU.

messages: The PSU in slot arg1 detected 220 VAC input voltage and does not match chassis configuration.
records.explanation: The input voltage of the PSU specified in the message does not match the input voltage of the PSUs already present in the chassis.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following: 1) Check if the input voltage of all the PSUs are the same. 2) If the input voltage of
the PSU specified in the message is not the same, then remove the unmatched PSU.

messages: Unable to update the firmware for the PSU in slot arg1. Error=0xarg2 (arg3)
records.explanation: The firmware update operation for the PSU identified in the message did not complete, because of internal communication errors.
records.cause: The firmware update operation for the PSU identified in the message did not complete, because of internal communication errors.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the firmware update operation. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Unable to complete the PSU slot arg1 firmware update. Error=0xarg2.
records.explanation: Unable to update the PSU firmware due to PMBus communication errors.
records.cause: Unable to update the PSU firmware due to PMBus communication errors.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the firmware update operation. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Unable to set the Enable Dynamic Power Supply Engagement attribute.
records.explanation: Unable to set the Enable Dynamic Power Supply Engagement attribute.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following: 1) Retry the operation. 2) If the issue persists, review the tracelog for more
details. To retrieve the tracelog, in the CMC Web interface, go to Troubleshooting > Diagnostics
page and enter the "gettracelog" command, or use RACADM "gettracelog" command. If the issue
persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/
support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and
recommend a resolution.

messages: Unable to access the PSU arg1 FRU data.
records.explanation: The operation to read the FRU data from the PSU identified in the message did not complete successfully due to internal communication errors.
records.cause: The operation to read the FRU data from the PSU identified in the message did not complete successfully due to internal communication errors.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the operation. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC.
Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant
to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Enhanced Dynamic Power Supply Engagement (DPSE) is not supported by the current power supply configuration and is suspended.
records.explanation: The Dynamic Power Supply Engagement (DPSE) feature is suspended due to the configuration or the type of PSU present. The feature is enabled, but suspended until a supported PSU configuration is in place.
records.cause: The Dynamic Power Supply Engagement (DPSE) feature is suspended due to the configuration or the type of PSU present. The feature is enabled, but suspended until a supported PSU configuration is in place.
records.recommended_action:
Dynamic Power Supply Engagement (DPSE) is not supported by the current power supply
configuration. Verify the PSUs are supported. Replace the unsupported PSUs.

messages: PSU arg1 exceeded upper temperature threshold and has been turned off.
records.explanation: The power supply unit (PSU) identified in the message was turned off because the temperature exceeded the high temperature threshold in the unit.
records.cause: The power supply unit (PSU) identified in the message was turned off because the temperature exceeded the high temperature threshold in the unit.
records.recommended_action:
Remove and reinsert the PSU or remove AC power and reapply power to the PSU to get it functional
again.

messages: PSU arg1 reported input over current fault and has been turned off.
records.explanation: The power supply unit (PSU) identified in the message was turned off because the input over current fault occurred.
records.cause: The power supply unit (PSU) identified in the message was turned off because the input over current fault occurred.
records.recommended_action:
1) Verify system load is within PSU capacity and no short circuits are present in the system.
2) Remove AC power and reapply power to the PSU to get it functional again. 3) If the issue
persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/
support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and
recommend a resolution.

messages: The system power is automatically recovered because of an AC brownout in the power supply unit (PSU).
records.explanation: The system power is automatically recovered because of an AC brownout in the power supply unit (PSU).
records.cause: The system power is automatically recovered because of an AC brownout in the power supply unit (PSU).
records.recommended_action:
Do one of the following: 1) Make sure that the system load is within the power capacity of power
supply unit (PSU) and no short circuit exists. 2) Make sure that the AC input to the PSU is correct.
For information about input voltage specifications, see the "CMC Technical Guide". 3) Disconnect
the power supply and reconnect. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Unable to update the firmware of Power Supply Unit (PSU) in the chassis slot arg1 because either the chassis power is on, PSU input power is unavailable, or chassis has insufficient number of working PSUs. Error=0xarg2 (arg3).
records.explanation: The firmware update operation of Power Supply Unit (PSU) in the chassis slot identified in the message can not complete because either the chassis power is on, PSU input power is unavailable, or chassis has insufficient number of working PSUs.
records.cause: The firmware update operation of Power Supply Unit (PSU) in the chassis slot identified in the message can not complete because either the chassis power is on, PSU input power is unavailable, or chassis has insufficient number of working PSUs.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the operation. If the issue persists, do the following and retry the operation: 1) Power OFF the
chassis. 2) Make sure that the chassis has properly working PSUs. 3) Make sure that the PSUs have
input power.

messages: Unable to update the firmware of Power Supply Unit (PSU) in the chassis slot arg1 because either the iDRAC or Module Management unit is not functioning because of a previous firmware update operation. Error=0xarg2 (arg3).
records.explanation: The firmware update operation of Power Supply Unit (PSU) in the chassis slot identified in the message did not complete because either the iDRAC or Module Management unit is not functioning because of a previous firmware update operation.
records.cause: The firmware update operation of Power Supply Unit (PSU) in the chassis slot identified in the message did not complete because either the iDRAC or Module Management unit is not functioning because of a previous firmware update operation.
records.recommended_action:
Reset the iDRAC or Management Module, and then retry the operation. If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: Unable to update the firmware of Power Supply Unit (PSU) in the chassis slot arg1 because update package is not supported. Error=0xarg2 (arg3).
records.explanation: The firmware update operation of Power Supply Unit (PSU) in the chassis slot identified in the message did not complete because update package is not supported.
records.cause: The firmware update operation of Power Supply Unit (PSU) in the chassis slot identified in the message did not complete because update package is not supported.
records.recommended_action:
Download the latest update package from your service provider and then retry the operation.
If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://
www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze
the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Unable to set the chassis redundancy policy to PSU Redundancy.
records.explanation: The chassis redundancy policy could not be set to the PSU Redundancy mode.
records.recommended_action:
Do one of the following and retry the operation: 1) On the OpenManage Enterprise-Modular
Graphical User Interface (GUI) click Settings > Power. Under Redundancy Configuration, select PSU
Redundancy. 2) At the Command Line Interface (CLI), enter the RACADM command: "racadm config
-g cfgChassisPower -o cfgChassisRedundancyPolicy 1".

messages: The temperature of Power Supply Unit arg1 exceeded upper temperature threshold and has been turned off.
records.explanation: The Power Supply Unit (PSU) identified in the message was automatically powered off because the temperature exceeded the upper temperature threshold in the unit.
records.cause: The Power Supply Unit (PSU) identified in the message was automatically powered off because the temperature exceeded the upper temperature threshold in the unit.
records.recommended_action:
1) Manually remove and reinstall the Power Supply Unit (PSU) or disconnect the input power. 2) Press
and hold the power button for 30 seconds. The PSU is powered on.

messages: The Power Supply Unit arg1 reported an input undervoltage fault and has been turned off.
records.explanation: The Power Supply Unit (PSU) identified in the message was turned off because the input undervoltage fault occurred.
records.cause: The Power Supply Unit (PSU) identified in the message was turned off because the input undervoltage fault occurred.
records.recommended_action:
1) Check the Power Supply Unit (PSU)input power source. 2) Press and hold the power button for 30
seconds. The PSU is powered on. 3) If the issue persists, contact technical support.

messages: Power supply arg1 is absent.
records.explanation: The supply has been removed or has failed.
records.recommended_action: Install the power supply if needed.

messages: The Dynamic Power Supply Engagement (DPSE) feature cannot be enabled because the Extended Power Performance mode is enabled.
records.explanation: The Dynamic Power Supply Engagement (DPSE) feature cannot be enabled because the Extended Power Performance mode is enabled.
records.cause: The Dynamic Power Supply Engagement (DPSE) feature cannot be enabled because the Extended Power Performance mode is enabled.
records.recommended_action: Disable Extended Power Performance and retry the operation.

messages: Unable to change the redundancy policy to either Power Supply Redundancy or No Redundancy because the Extended Power Performance is enabled.
records.explanation: The redundancy policy cannot be changed to either Power Supply Redundancy or No Redundancy because the Extended Power Performance is enabled.
records.cause: The redundancy policy cannot be changed to either Power Supply Redundancy or No Redundancy because the Extended Power Performance is enabled.
records.recommended_action: Disable Extended Power Performance and retry the operation.

messages: Cannot enable the Extended Power Performance (EPP) mode because Dynamic Power Supply Engagement (DPSE) is enabled.
records.explanation: Cannot enable the Extended Power Performance (EPP) mode because Dynamic Power Supply Engagement (DPSE) is enabled.
records.cause: Cannot enable the Extended Power Performance (EPP) mode because Dynamic Power Supply Engagement (DPSE) is enabled.
records.recommended_action: Disable Dynamic Power Supply Engagement (DPSE) and retry the operation.

messages: The Extended Power Performance (EPP) feature cannot be enabled because the PSU in slot arg1 is not a 3000 W PSU.
records.explanation: The Extended Power Performance (EPP) feature cannot be enabled because PSU in the slot identified in the message is not a 3000 W PSU.
records.cause: The Extended Power Performance (EPP) feature cannot be enabled because PSU in the slot identified in the message is not a 3000 W PSU.
records.recommended_action:
In order to use the Extended Power Performance (EPP) feature, replace the PSU identified in the
message with a 3000 W PSU.

messages: The input current limit of either the grid or Chassis is disabled on the sled arg1 because the iDRAC firmware version does not support the Grid or Chassis Input Current Limit feature.
records.explanation: The input current limit of either the grid or Chassis is disabled on the sled identified in the message because the iDRAC firmware version does not support the Grid or Chassis Input Current Limit feature.
records.cause: The input current limit of either the grid or Chassis is disabled on the sled identified in the message because the iDRAC firmware version does not support the Grid or Chassis Input Current Limit feature.
records.recommended_action:
Upgrade iDRAC to the same version as the other sleds in the chassis. For information about upgrading
iDRAC, see the iDRAC Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: Unable to turn on the server because the chassis infrastructure not ready.
records.explanation: The server did not turn on because the chassis infrastructure is not ready. The chassis infrastructure includes: PCIe subsystem, storage components, and the management module.
records.cause: The server did not turn on because the chassis infrastructure is not ready. The chassis infrastructure includes: PCIe subsystem, storage components, and the management module.
records.recommended_action:
Check the status of the chassis infrastructure in the Management Module (MM) interface. Wait until
the chassis infrastructure components are fully turned on.

messages: Unable to turn on the server because a Mezzanine card is incompatible with the I/O Module or PCIe subsystem.
records.explanation: The server did not turn on because an NDC or Mezzanine card is incompatible with the I/O Module or PCIe subsystem.
records.cause: The server did not turn on because an NDC or Mezzanine card is incompatible with the I/O Module or PCIe subsystem.
records.recommended_action: Check the release notes for the product and make sure to install compatible components in the server.

messages: Unable to allocate power for servers to turn on because the Management Module (MM) is initializing chassis infrastructure components.
records.explanation: The chassis infrastructure components are being initialized and are not ready to grant power on permission to the servers.
records.cause: Unable to allocate power for servers to turn on because the Management Module (MM) is initializing chassis infrastructure components.
records.recommended_action:
Wait until the chassis infrastructure has been initialized and then retry the operation. To check that
the infrastructure is initialized, using the RACADM command line utility run the command "racadm
getmodinfo" and check that the "pwrstate" field is on for the chassis component.

messages: Unable to turn on the server because the chassis infrastructure not ready.
records.explanation: The server did not turn on because the chassis infrastructure is not ready. The chassis infrastructure includes: PCIe subsystem, storage components, and the chassis management controller/Management Module.
records.cause: The server did not turn on because the chassis infrastructure is not ready. The chassis infrastructure includes: PCIe subsystem, storage components, and the chassis management controller/Management Module.
records.recommended_action:
Check the status of the chassis infrastructure in the CMC/MM Web or RACADM interface. Wait until
the chassis infrastructure components are fully turned on.

messages: Unable to turn on the server because an NDC or Mezzanine card is incompatible with the I/O Module or PCIe subsystem.
records.explanation: The server did not turn on because an NDC or Mezzanine card is incompatible with the I/O Module or PCIe subsystem.
records.cause: The server did not turn on because an NDC or Mezzanine card is incompatible with the I/O Module or PCIe subsystem.
records.recommended_action: Check the release notes for the product and make sure to install compatible components in the server.

messages: The use of 110V is unacknowledged and the chassis cannot grant power on permission to the server.
records.explanation: The use of 110V is unacknowledged for the chassis and the chassis cannot grant power on permission to the server.
records.recommended_action:
Check for unacknowledged use of 110V and change to acknowledged. Using the Chassis
Management Controller/Management Module (CMC/MM) web interface, select Chassis
Overview>Power>Configuration and then check the 110V Acknowledge field. Retry the operation to
turn on the server.

messages: The Chassis Management Controller/Management Module (CMC/MM) is configured in Max Power Conservation Mode and is unable to grant power on permission to the server.
records.explanation: The Chassis Management Controller/Management Module (CMC/MM) is configured in Max Power Conservation Mode and is unable to grant power on permission to the server.
records.recommended_action:
Disable the Max Power Conservation Mode on the chassis and retry the operation. Using the
Chassis Management Controller/Management Module (CMC/MM) web interface, select Chassis
Overview>Power>Configuration and then uncheck the Max Power Conservation Mode field.

messages: Unable to allocate power for servers to turn on because the Chassis Management Controller/ Management Module (CMC/MM) is initializing chassis infrastructure components.
records.explanation: The chassis infrastructure components are being initialized and are not ready to grant power on permission to the servers.
records.cause: Unable to allocate power for servers to turn on because the Chassis Management Controller/ Management Module (CMC/MM) is initializing chassis infrastructure components.
records.recommended_action:
Wait until the chassis infrastructure has been initialized and then retry the operation. To check that
the infrastructure is initialized, using the RACADM command line utility run the command "racadm
getmodinfo" and check that the "pwrstate" field is on for the chassis component.

messages: The Intel Management Engine is unresponsive and the server thermal failsafe state is activated.
records.explanation: The iDRAC experienced an IPMB communication issue with the Intel Management Engine and was not able to recover IPMB communications. The server thermal failsafe state is activated.
records.recommended_action:
Disconnect power from the server and reconnect power. Turn on the server. If the issue persists,
Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/
incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and
recommend a resolution.

messages: Current Monitor initialization issue observed, IMON Revision arg1, CPLD IMON MFR Revision arg2.
records.explanation: The iDRAC experienced an issue initializing the Current Monitor. The system motherboard may need replacement.
records.recommended_action:
If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://
www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze
the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: The power supply unit (PSU) arg1 is disabled because of a configuration mismatch and therefore the PSU is not supported on the server.
records.explanation: The power supply unit (PSU) identified in the message is disabled because of a configuration mismatch and therefore the PSU is not supported on the server.
records.cause: The power supply unit (PSU) identified in the message is disabled because of a configuration mismatch and therefore the PSU is not supported on the server.
records.recommended_action:
Install a supported power supply unit (PSU). For information about supported PSUs, see the product
documentation available on the support site.If it is a supported PSU in this configuration, reseat the
PSU.

messages: The power supply unit (PSU) arg1 is disabled because of a generation mismatch and therefore the PSU is not supported on the server.
records.explanation: The power supply unit (PSU) identified in the message is disabled because of a generation mismatch and therefore the PSU is not supported on the server.
records.cause: The power supply unit (PSU) identified in the message is disabled because of a generation mismatch and therefore the PSU is not supported on the server.
records.recommended_action:
Install a supported power supply unit (PSU). For information about PSUs of supported generations,
see the product documentation available on the support site.

messages: The power supply unit (PSU) arg1 is disabled because of a capacity mismatch and therefore the PSU is not supported on the server.
records.explanation: The power supply unit (PSU) identified in the message is disabled because of a capacity mismatch and therefore the PSU is not supported on the server.
records.cause: The power supply unit (PSU) identified in the message is disabled because of a capacity mismatch and therefore the PSU is not supported on the server.
records.recommended_action:
Install a supported power supply unit (PSU). For information about PSUs of supported capacities, see
the product documentation available on the support site.

messages: The power supply unit (PSU) arg1 is disabled because of a mismatch in the input voltage and therefore the PSU is not supported on the server.
records.explanation: The power supply unit (PSU) identified in the message is disabled because of a mismatch in the input voltage and therefore the PSU is not supported on the server.
records.cause: The power supply unit (PSU) identified in the message is disabled because of a mismatch in the input voltage and therefore the PSU is not supported on the server.
records.recommended_action:
Install a power supply unit (PSU) that has similar input voltage. For information about supported
PSUs, see the product documentation available on the support site.

messages: Unable to turn on the server because of current power settings in the chassis.
records.explanation: The Management Module is unable to grant power-on permission to the server because of current power settings in the chassis.
records.cause: The Management Module is unable to grant power-on permission to the server because of current power settings in the chassis.
records.recommended_action: Check the chassis power settings in Management Service Module and retry the operation.

messages: Unable to turn on the server because of current chassis storage setup or the chassis storage settings.
records.explanation: The Enclosure Controller is unable to grant power-on permission to the server because of current chassis storage setup or the chassis storage settings.
records.cause: The Enclosure Controller is unable to grant power-on permission to the server because of current chassis storage setup or the chassis storage settings.
records.recommended_action:
Check the chassis storage setup or chassis storage settings in the Management Service Module and
retry the operation.

messages: Unable to perform the memory arming operation because the PSU configuration of the server is insufficient to guarantee data flush time in the event of power loss.
records.explanation: The memory arming operation cannot be performed because the PSU configuration of the server is insufficient to guarantee data flush time in the event of power loss.
records.cause: The memory arming operation cannot be performed because the PSU configuration of the server is insufficient to guarantee data flush time in the event of power loss.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following and retry the operation. 1) Turn off the server 2) Ensure proper PSUs are installed as
recommended in user guide 3) Turn on the server. For more information about supported PSUs, see
the documentation on the support site.

messages: The Chassis Manager is unable to obtain valid power allocation values because of an internal error.
records.explanation: The Chassis Manager is unable to obtain valid power allocation values because of an internal error.
records.recommended_action:
Do one of the following and retry the operation: 1) Wait few seconds and retry. 2) Reset iDRAC. 3)
Remove the server and reinsert in the chassis.

messages: Power required by the system exceeds the power supplied by the Chassis Manager.
records.explanation: Power required by the system exceeds the power supplied by the Chassis Manager.
records.recommended_action:
Do one of the following and retry the operation: 1) Update the Power Supply Unit (PSU) or sled
configuration to enable the Chassis Manager to allocate more power. To configure the PSU and sled
properties, run the "racadm racreset" RACADM command at the Command Line Interface (CLI). 2)
Turn off one of the sleds. 3) Add more PSUs.

messages: The server power-on operation is cancelled because of issues in the BIOS image verification process.
records.explanation: The server power-on operation is cancelled because of issues in the BIOS image verification process. The BIOS image file is either corrupted or compromised.
records.cause: The server power-on operation is cancelled because of issues in the BIOS image verification process. The BIOS image file is either corrupted or compromised.
records.recommended_action: Initiate the BIOS recovery process by using a Dell supported BIOS image file.

messages: Unable to power on the mezzanine adapters in the server because of insufficient power availability.
records.explanation: The mezzanine adapters in the server cannot be powered on because of insufficient power availability.
records.cause: The mezzanine adapters in the server cannot be powered on because of insufficient power availability.
records.recommended_action:
Log in to the management module web interface and verify the available power and blade standby
power requirements. For more information about managing Power Supply Units (PSU), see the
management module Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: Unable to read the OCP NIC information because the management module cannot verify the power requirements of the OCP NIC.
records.explanation: The OCP NIC information cannot be read because management module is unable to verify the power requirements of the OCP NIC. This can be because either the OCP NICs FRU data or because the FRU data is unavailable.
records.cause: The OCP NIC information cannot be read because management module is unable to verify the power requirements of the OCP NIC. This can be because either the OCP NICs FRU data or because the FRU data is unavailable.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following and retry the operation: 1) Reset the management module by running the following
command at the Command Line Interface (CLI): racadm racreset 2) Manually reseat the OCP
NIC in the server. For instructions about reseating the OCP NIC, see the Installation and Service
Manual of the respective server model available on the support site. If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: The power supply unit (PSU) arg1 is disabled because of mismatch in the airflow direction and therefore the PSU is not supported on the server.
records.explanation: The power supply unit (PSU) identified in the message is disabled because of a mismatch in the airflow direction and therefore the PSU is not supported on the server.
records.cause: The power supply unit (PSU) identified in the message is disabled because of a mismatch in the airflow direction and therefore the PSU is not supported on the server.
records.recommended_action:
Install a power supply unit (PSU) that has a similar airflow direction. For information about PSUs of
supported airflow directions, see the product documentation available on the support site.

messages: Server could not power on at this time. Enclosure Controller is trying to switch to optimized boot mode. Make sure all other sleds are fully booted to operating system and try again to power up.
records.explanation: Server could not power on at this time. Enclosure Controller is trying to switch to optimized boot mode. Make sure all other sleds are fully booted to operating system and try again to power up.
records.recommended_action:
Server could not power on at this time. Enclosure Controller is trying to switch to optimized boot
mode. Make sure all other sleds are fully booted to operating system and try again to power up.

messages: Unable to complete the firmware update operation of the voltage regulator (VR) arg1 because arg2.
records.explanation: The firmware update of the voltage regulator (VR) identified in the message did not complete successfully because of the reason specified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
AC cycle the system by disconnecting and reconnecting input power. If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: Unable to complete the firmware update operation of the voltage regulator (VR) arg1 because arg2.
records.explanation: The firmware update of the voltage regulator (VR) identified in the message did not complete successfully because of the reason specified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
Do one of the following: 1) Power off the system. Reset iDRAC. Power on the system. 2) AC
cycle the system by disconnecting and reconnecting input power. If the issue persists, Collect a
SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: The Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) in the slot arg1 is unable to maintain the power limit.
records.explanation: The Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) in the slot identified in the message is unable to maintain the power limit.
records.recommended_action:
Check the operating system driver support. If the issue persists, then provide this iDRAC Lifecycle log
to the Technical Support team.

messages: The input voltage for the Power Supply Unit PSU.Slot.arg1 is not detected.
records.explanation: The input voltage for Power Supply Unit (PSU) in the slot identified in the message is not detected. The power supply is installed correctly but an input source is not connected or is not functional.
records.recommended_action:
Verify the input power or power cord connection. If the issue persists, manually reseat the PSU. For
information about reseating the PSU, see the Installation and Service Manual (ISM) of the respective
PowerEdge server model available on the support site.

messages: Power management firmware unable to maintain power limit.
records.explanation: The power management firmware cannot reduce power consumption to meet configuration or user defined settings.
records.recommended_action: 1) Review system power policy. 2) Check system event logs for thermal or power related exceptions.

messages: Power management firmware initialization error.
records.explanation: The iDRAC controller detected that the power management firmware did not initialize properly. The system may operate in a performance degraded state.
records.recommended_action:
1) Disconnect system input power, wait one minute, reconnect system input power.2) Re-flash system
BIOS.3) Upgrade system BIOS to the latest revision.

messages: iDRAC is unable to communicate with power management firmware.
records.explanation: The iDRAC controller cannot communicate with the power management firmware due to an problem with the interface to the power management engine or with the power management engine itself. The system may operate in a performance degraded state.
records.cause: The iDRAC controller cannot communicate with the power management firmware due to an problem with the interface to the power management engine or with the power management engine itself. The system may operate in a performance degraded state.
records.recommended_action:
Check the Lifecycle Controller Log (LC Log) and make sure that there are no subsequent log entries
indicating that Communication with power management firmware has been restored. If this log entry
is not present then do one of the following: 1) Disconnect system input power, wait one minute,
reconnect system input power. 2) Re-flash system BIOS. 3) Upgrade system BIOS to the latest
revision.

messages: An issue is observed in a processor power source on component arg1, (arg2).
records.explanation: An issue is observed in the power source of the component identified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
Restart the server using the minimum processor configuration. If the boot operation is successful then
restore the server configuration but one component at a time. If unsuccessful, replace the component
indicated in the message. For more information about the steps to recover from this issue, see the
Field Service Manual (FSM).

messages: The Dynamic Power Supply Engagement feature was not successfully enabled.
records.explanation: The Dynamic Power Supply Engagement feature was not successfully enabled.
records.recommended_action:
Restart the Chassis Management Controller and retry the operation. To restart the Chassis
Management Controller, using the WEB UI, go to Chassis Overview > Power > Control, select the
Reset CMC option, and then click Apply.

messages: Unable to set chassis power property arg1.
records.explanation: Unable to set the chassis power identified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the operation. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC.
Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant
to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Unable to set the CHASSIS_POWER_button_disable chassis power property.
records.explanation: Unable to set the CHASSIS_POWER_button_disable chassis power property.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the operation. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC.
Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant
to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Unable to perform chassis power action due to insufficient privileges.
records.explanation: The user account credentials provided for this chassis power action do not have the correct privilege. Chassis control privilege is required to perform chassis power actions.
records.cause: Unable to perform chassis power action due to insufficient privileges.
records.recommended_action: Retry to action with a different user account that has chassis power control privilege.

messages: Unable to turn off chassis power.
records.explanation: Chassis power state transition did not complete successfully. This may be due to one of the following: 1) Unable to turn off one or more servers, 2) A firmware update may be in progress.
records.cause: Chassis power state transition did not complete successfully. This may be due to one of the following: 1) Unable to turn off one or more servers, 2) A firmware update may be in progress.
records.recommended_action:
Check the tracelog for more information. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR)
report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use
the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Chassis Management Controller turned off the Server arg1 because of insufficient power at inventory.
records.explanation: Insufficient power is available for the server identified in the message to function. The server will be turned off until there is sufficient power available.
records.cause: Chassis Management Controller turned off the Server arg1 because of insufficient power at inventory.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure there is enough power supply to distribute power. Using the CMC Web UI, go to Chassis
Overview > Power > Power Budget Status. In the Total Input Power Available For Allocation field view
the available power. To add more power, insert more PSUs or remove unused components from the
chassis.

messages: Chassis Management Controller turned off the server arg1 because of incorrect power data retrieved from iDRAC at inventory.
records.explanation: Incorrect power inventory information reported by the iDRAC for the server identified in the message.
records.cause: Chassis Management Controller turned off the server arg1 because of incorrect power data retrieved from iDRAC at inventory.
records.recommended_action:
Invalid power inventory information could be due to outdated iDRAC firmware or server BIOS firmware
versions. Update the components to their latest versions.

messages: Chassis Management Controller is unable to turn on arg1-arg2 because of insufficient power.
records.explanation: There is insufficient power for the component identified in the message to turn on.
records.cause: Chassis Management Controller is unable to turn on arg1-arg2 because of insufficient power.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure there is enough power supply to distribute power. Using the CMC Web UI, go to Chassis
Overview > Power > Power Budget Status. In the Total Input Power Available For Allocation field
view the available power. To add more power, insert more PSUs or remove unused components
