records.recommended_action:
Make sure that the recommended license is installed on the server and retry the operation. For
information about compatible license versions, see the iDRAC or Open Server Manager (OSM) Users
Guide available on the support site.

messages: Unable to update the arg1 firmware because the required CPLD is currently not installed on the target system.
records.explanation: The firmware of the component identified in the message cannot be updated because the required CPLD is currently not installed on the target system.
records.cause: The firmware of the component identified in the message cannot be updated because the required CPLD is currently not installed on the target system.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that the recommended CPLD is installed on the server and retry the operation. For
information about compatible CPLD versions, see the iDRAC or Open Server Manager (OSM) Users
Guide available on the support site.

messages: Unable to update the arg1 firmware because the required Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) ID is currently not installed on the target system.
records.explanation: The firmware of the component identified in the message cannot be updated because the required Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) ID is currently not installed on the target system.
records.cause: The firmware of the component identified in the message cannot be updated because the required Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) ID is currently not installed on the target system.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that the recommended Original EquipmentManufacturer (OEM) ID is installed on the server
and retry the operation. For information about compatible Original EquipmentManufacturer (OEM) ID
versions, see the iDRAC or Open Server Manager (OSM) Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: Unable to update the arg1 firmware because the required BIOS is currently not installed on the target system.
records.explanation: The firmware of the component identified in the message cannot be updated because the required BIOS is currently not installed on the target system.
records.cause: The firmware of the component identified in the message cannot be updated because the required BIOS is currently not installed on the target system.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that the recommended BIOS is installed on the server and retry the operation. For
information about compatible BIOS versions, see the iDRAC or Open Server Manager (OSM) Users
Guide available on the support site.

messages: Unable to perform firmware update because Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) is in the locked state.
records.explanation: Unable to update the firmware version because the Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) is not unlocked to perform the update. One or more pre-requisite components are missing.
records.cause: Unable to update the firmware version because the Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) is not unlocked to perform the update. One or more pre-requisite components are missing.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that the recommended pre-requisite components are installed on the server and then retry
updating the firmware. For information about the required compatible components, see the iDRAC/
Open Server Manager (OSM) Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: Unable to create the job because a CPLD firmware job and non-CPLD job cannot be performed at the same time.
records.explanation: The firmware cannot be updated on the devices in the list because it has both CPLD and non-CPLD firmware types.
records.cause: The firmware cannot be updated on the devices in the list because it has both CPLD and non-CPLD firmware types.
records.recommended_action:
1) Select the check box corresponding to the firmware to be updated, and then click Install. The
selected firmware is installed. If the list has both types of firmware update packages then either
CPLD or non-CPLD firmware is grayed out based on the type of firmware first listed. For example,
if a CPLD-based firmware is listed first in the Update Details section, then subsequent non-CPLD
based firmware will be grayed out and cannot be selected. 2) After successfully updating the selected
firmware, retry updating the firmware that was earlier grayed out.3) Make sure there is no other Job
already running if you are updating the CPLD firmware.

messages: Unable to update arg1 firmware to arg2 due to internal error.
records.explanation: Unable to update firmware for the indicated device to the identified firmware version.
records.recommended_action: Retry the firmware update.

messages: Unable to create the job because a DPU BMC firmware job and non-DPU BMC job cannot be performed at the same time.
records.explanation: The firmware cannot be updated on the devices in the list because it has both DPU BMC and non-DPU BMC firmware types.
records.cause: The firmware cannot be updated on the devices in the list because it has both DPU BMC and non-DPU BMC firmware types.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following:-1) Select the check box corresponding to the firmware to be updated, and then
click Install. The selected firmware is installed. If the list has both types of firmware update packages
then either DPU BMC or non-DPU BMC firmware is grayed out based on the type of firmware
first listed. For example, if a DPU BMC-based firmware is listed first in the Update Details section,
then subsequent non-DPU BMC based firmware will be grayed out and cannot be selected. 2) After
successfully updating the selected firmware, retry updating the firmware that was earlier grayed out.
3) Make sure there is no other Job already running if you are updating the DPU BMC firmware.

messages: Unable to update the heater module firmware because the host system is powered on.
records.explanation: The heater module firmware cannot be updated because the host system is powered on.
records.cause: The heater module firmware cannot be updated because the host system is powered on.
records.recommended_action:
Power off the heater module and retry the operation. For information about a heater module, see the
iDRAC Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: Failure updating firmware of arg1 from version arg2 to version arg3 because arg4.
records.explanation: A firmware update operation was not successful for the given individual device with the version numbers for that individual device. The fromversion may be different from other similar devices receiving the same update. reason may be blank, "N/A", or "unknown" if it was not able to determine the reason.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure prerequisites are met and no other update is in progress for the device. Retry the
operation.

messages: Removable Flash Media is not IPMI-function ready.
records.explanation: The removable flash media is installed but improperly configured or failed to initialize.
records.recommended_action: If unintended, reinstall the flash media.

messages: Removable Flash Media is offline.
records.explanation: At boot, the Card Identification (CID) signature of the card is different from the Non-volatile (NV) storage value or the card is the destination of a copy operation that is in-progress.
records.recommended_action: If unintended, reinstall the flash media.

messages: Failure detected on Removable Flash Media.
records.explanation: An error is reported during a SD card read or write.
records.recommended_action: Re-install the flash media, if the issue persists replace the media.

messages: Removable Flash Media is write protected.
records.explanation: The card is write-protected by the physical latch on the SD card. IDSDM cannot use a write-protected card.
records.recommended_action: If unintended, remove the media and disable write protection.

messages: Media not present for Removable Flash Media.
records.explanation: The SD card is not detected or not installed.
records.recommended_action: If unintended, reinstall the flash media.

messages: Unable to perform the Secured Component Verification (SCV) operation because of insufficient drive space in the system to upload the Delta certificate.
records.explanation: The Secured Component Verification (SCV) operation cannot be performed because of insufficient drive space in the system to upload the Delta certificate.
records.cause: The Secured Component Verification (SCV) operation cannot be performed because of insufficient drive space in the system to upload the Delta certificate.
records.recommended_action:
Remove the existing Delta certificate, upload the latest certificate that has the consolidated data, and
then retry the operation. For more information about SCV, see the Secured Component Verification
(SCV) Reference Guide available on the support site.

messages: The plugin arg1 was not started because the management controller firmware does not support this version of plugin.
records.explanation: The plugin identified in the message was not started because the plugin version is not compatible with the runningmanagement controllerversion.
records.cause: The plugin identified in the message was not started because the plugin version is not compatible with the runningmanagement controllerversion.
records.recommended_action:
Review the plugins documentation for which version ofmanagement controller firmware is required.
Update the plugin or update the management controller firmware to achieve version compatibility.

messages: A diagnostic warning event occurred on the Software Defined Persistent Memory (SDPM) virtual DIMM located at arg1. Check the device and system configuration. Extended ID: arg2.
records.explanation: A diagnostic warning event occurred in the memory device at location identified in the message. The device may be operating in a degraded state. Checking the device and system configuration is recommended for remediation.
records.recommended_action:
Review additional server health events available in the System Event Log. Ensure that the server and
device is in the recommended configuration per the respective PowerEdge servers Installation and
Service Manual available on the support site. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection
(TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic
to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: An unknown diagnostic warning event occurred on the Software Defined Persistent Memory (SDPM) virtual DIMM located at arg1. Extended ID: arg2.
records.explanation: An unknown diagnostic warning event occurred in the memory device at location identified in the message. iDRAC firmware must be updated to properly decode this event.
records.recommended_action:
Update iDRAC firmware to the latest version available. If the issue persists, Collect a
SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: A critical diagnostic event occurred on the Software Defined Persistent Memory (SDPM) virtual DIMM located at arg1. Check the device and system configuration. Extended ID: arg2.
records.explanation: A critical diagnostic event occurred in the memory device at location identified in the message. The device may be operating in a degraded state. Checking the device and system configuration is recommended for remediation.
records.recommended_action:
Ensure that the server and device is in the recommended configuration per the respective PowerEdge
servers Installation and Service Manual available on the support site. If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: A critical diagnostic event occurred on the Software Defined Persistent Memory (SDPM) virtual DIMM located at arg1 Extended ID: arg2.
records.explanation: A diagnostic critical event occurred in the memory device at location identified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://
www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze
the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: A critical diagnostic event occurred on the Software Defined Persistent Memory (SDPM) virtual DIMM located at arg1. Retry operation. Extended ID: arg2.
records.explanation: A critical diagnostic event occurred in the memory device at location identified in the message. The attempted operation on this device could not be completed. Retry operation.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the operation. If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC.
Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant
to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: A critical diagnostic event occurred on the Software Defined Persistent Memory (SDPM) virtual DIMM located at arg1. Sanitize the device. Extended ID: arg2.
records.explanation: A critical diagnostic event occurred in the memory device at location identified in the message. The memory device has detected an error during startup that either cannot be recovered or has been moved from another server, which has resulted in a unusable configuration data.
records.recommended_action:
To recover, sanitize the memory device in BIOS Settings. Sanitizing will delete all data on the device.
If the issue persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://
www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze
the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: Unable to arm the server because the fan configuration is not supported.
records.explanation: The server cannot be armed because the fan configuration is not supported. A Software Defined Persistent Memory (SDPM) server requires very high performance fans.
records.cause: The server cannot be armed because the fan configuration is not supported. A Software Defined Persistent Memory (SDPM) server requires very high performance fans.
records.recommended_action: Replace the server fans by using very high performance fans and retry the operation.

messages: An unknown critical diagnostic event occurred on the Software Defined Persistent Memory (SDPM) virtual DIMM located at arg1. Extended ID: arg2.
records.explanation: An unknown critical diagnostic event occurred in the memory device at location identified in the message. iDRAC firmware must be updated to properly decode this event.
records.recommended_action:
Update iDRAC firmware to the latest version available. If the issue persists, Collect a
SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: The drive bay is open.
records.explanation: The drive bay is open. A drive may be added or removed. System performance may be degraded.
records.recommended_action: Close the drive bay. Check system logs.

messages: The processor area is open.
records.explanation: The processor area is open. A drive may be added or removed. System performance may be degraded.
records.recommended_action: Close the processor area. Check system logs.

messages: The fan area is open.
records.explanation: The fan area is open. System performance may be degraded.
records.recommended_action: Close the fan area. Check system logs.

messages: The arg1 drive bay is kept open for an extended period of time.
records.explanation: The drive bay identified in the message is kept open for an extended period of time. This may result in excessive cooling of the components.
records.recommended_action:
Close the drive bay immediately. For information about drive bays, see the Installation and
Service Manual of the respective server on the support site. if the issue persists, Collect a
SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: The chassis is open while the power is on.
records.explanation: The chassis is open. System performance may be degraded, and security may be compromised.
records.recommended_action: Close the chassis. Check system logs.

messages: The chassis is open while the power is off.
records.explanation: The chassis is open while the power is off. System security may have been compromised.
records.recommended_action: Close the chassis and verify hardware inventory. Check system logs.

messages: BIOS is unable to configure the Intel Trusted Execution Technology (TXT).
records.explanation: TXT initialization cannot be completed because system configuration may have changed.
records.cause: TXT initialization cannot be completed because system configuration may have changed.
records.recommended_action:
Check system hardware inventory for TPM presence, clear and reconfigure TPM and TXT in BIOS
setup menu.

messages: Unable to determine the redundancy status of the chassis intrusion sensor.
records.explanation: The chassis may be open. This condition can lead to degraded system performance because of insufficient cooling and the system security may be compromised.
records.recommended_action: Close the chassis.

messages: Chassis intrusion sensor may have failed.
records.explanation: The chassis intrusion sensor may have failed, because of this it cannot be determined whether the chassis is closed or opened. This condition can lead to degraded system performance because of insufficient cooling. The system security may be compromised.
records.recommended_action: Replace the chassis intrusion sensor. For more information, contact your service provider.

messages: The arg1 in slot arg2 is open.
records.explanation: The Storage disk tray identified in the message is open. The tray should be closed as soon as any service action is completed. Leaving the tray open for an extended period may result in drives over heating.
records.recommended_action: Close the Storage disk tray identified in the message.

messages: The arg1 in slot arg2 is opened for more than 3 minutes.
records.explanation: The Storage disk tray in the slot identified in the message has been open for an extended period of time. The tray should be closed as soon as any service action is completed. Leaving it open for extended period may result in drives overheating.
records.recommended_action:
Close the Storage disk tray as it may affect the system performance or may cause hard drives to
overheat. Check system logs .

messages: Dell RMC card was either moved or powered on for the first time. Enable the card from the BIOS setup (F2) using a local monitor and keyboard.
records.explanation: The issue is as identified in the Message part.
records.recommended_action:
Dell RMC card was either moved or powered on for the first time. Enable the card from the BIOS
setup (F2) using a local monitor and keyboard.

messages: The KMS CA certificate will expire in arg1 days.
records.explanation: The KMS CA Certificate will expire in few days as identified in the message. If an updated certificate is not uploaded to iDRAC then the SEKM functionality will not be available and key exchange with storage controller could fail leading to data lockout.
records.recommended_action: Upload to iDRAC an updated CA certificate whose expiry date exceeds the expiry warning threshold.

messages: Unable to perform the Reset to Factory Defaults operation because the key management security feature is not disabled on iDRAC.
records.explanation: The Reset to Factory Defaults operation cannot be performed because the Secure Enterprise Key Manager (SEKM) or iDRAC Local Key Management feature is not disabled on iDRAC. Disabling key management security feature is a pre-requisite because the Reset To Factory Defaults operation will reset the key management security feature that could result in secured devices not getting unlocked, and therefore data on these devices becoming inaccessible.
records.cause: The Reset to Factory Defaults operation cannot be performed because the Secure Enterprise Key Manager (SEKM) or iDRAC Local Key Management feature is not disabled on iDRAC. Disabling key management security feature is a pre-requisite because the Reset To Factory Defaults operation will reset the key management security feature that could result in secured devices not getting unlocked, and therefore data on these devices becoming inaccessible.
records.recommended_action:
Disable the key management security feature, Secure Enterprise Key Manager (SEKM), or iDRAC
Local Key Management (iLKM) by running the following RACADM command at the Command Line
Interface (CLI), and then retry the operation: For SEKM: racadm sekm disable. For iLKM: racadm iLKM
disable.

messages: iDRAC is unable to secure arg1 because the device is not currently supported by iDRAC.
records.explanation: iDRAC cannot secure the device identified in the message because either iDRAC does not support the device type, the device firmware is incompatible, or the device does not use the encryption protocol supported by iDRAC. For example, TCG Opal 2.0 or later using SMBUS. Therefore, iDRAC cannot secure the device.
records.cause: iDRAC cannot secure the device identified in the message because either iDRAC does not support the device type, the device firmware is incompatible, or the device does not use the encryption protocol supported by iDRAC. For example, TCG Opal 2.0 or later using SMBUS. Therefore, iDRAC cannot secure the device.
records.recommended_action:
1) No response action is required if the device is to be used in a non-secure mode. 2) Otherwise
ensure that the device has the correct firmware version that supports security or is of the type
supported by iDRAC.

messages: iDRAC is unable to unlock the device arg1 as it could not get the key ID arg2.
records.explanation: iDRAC was unable to unlock a secured drive due to error communicating with the Key Management Server. The drive is in a locked state and no data access is possible.
records.cause: iDRAC was unable to unlock a secured drive due to error communicating with the Key Management Server. The drive is in a locked state and no data access is possible.
records.recommended_action:
1) Ensure that the network connectivity to the Key Management Server from iDRAC can be
established. 2) Ensure that iDRAC has access to the required key id on the Key Management
Server. 3) If iDRAC is in the iLKM mode then restart iDRAC and retry the operation. If the issue
persists, Collect a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/
support/incidents-online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and
recommend a resolution.

messages: iDRAC is unable to unlock arg1. Error response from the device: arg2.
records.explanation: iDRAC was unable to unlock a secured drive due to error communicating with the device. The drive is in a locked state and no data access is possible.
records.cause: iDRAC was unable to unlock a secured drive due to error communicating with the device. The drive is in a locked state and no data access is possible.
records.recommended_action:
1) Ensure that the device supports the security protocol support viaSMBus (TCG Opal or TCG
Enterprise)2) Ensure that the Security Send/Receivecommands are supported via SMBus3) Ensure
that the device has the latestfirmware.4) Check if the drive security status is foreign - locked by
anentity other than iDRAC.5) Check if iDRAC is in Local Key Management mode andthe drive was
secured by iDRAC in Secure Enterprise Key Manager mode.

messages: iDRAC is unable to rekey the device arg1 using key identifiers: arg2.
records.explanation: iDRAC was unable to rekey a secured drive. If iDRAC was able to retrieve the drive key from the Key Management Server then the drive is unlocked, and data access is possible. If the drive key was not accessible from the Key Management Server then the drive could not be unlocked, and no data is accessible.
records.recommended_action:
1) Ensure that the network connectivity to the Key Management Serverfrom iDRAC can be
established.2) Ensure that iDRAC has access to the requiredkey identifier on the Key Management
Server.

messages: iDRAC is unable to rekey the device arg1. Error response from the device arg2.
records.explanation: iDRAC was unable to rekey a secured drive. If the drive could not be unlocked then no data is accessible. If the drive could be unlocked then data is accessible.
records.recommended_action:
1) Ensure that the device supports the security protocol support viaSMBus (TCG Opal or TCG
Enterprise).2) Ensure that the Security Send/Receivecommands are supported via SMBus.3) Ensure
that the device has the latestfirmware.4) Check if iDRAC is in Local Key Management mode and the
drive wassecured by iDRAC in Secure Enterprise Key Manager mode.

messages: iDRAC is unable to cryptographic erase the device arg1. using key identifiers: arg2.
records.explanation: iDRAC was unable to cryptographic erase a secured drive and data is accessible on the drive.
records.recommended_action:
1) Ensure that the network connectivity to the KMS from iDRAC can beestablished.2) Ensure that
iDRAC has access to the required key id on the KeyManagement Server.

messages: iDRAC is unable to cryptographic erase the device arg1. Error response from the device arg2.
records.explanation: iDRAC was unable to erase a secured drive and data is accessible on the drive.
records.recommended_action:
1) Ensure that the device supports the security protocol support viaSMBus (TCG Opal or TCG
Enterprise).2) Ensure that the Security Send/Receivecommands are supported via SMBus.3) Ensure
that the device has the latestfirmware.

messages: iDRAC is unable to update the firmware of the device arg1 because the firmware download port is disabled.
records.explanation: The firmware download port of devices that are not unlocked by iDRAC are automatically disabled. Therefore, iDRAC cannot update the firmware of the device identified in the message.
records.cause: iDRAC is unable to update the firmware of the device arg1 because the firmware download port is disabled.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure device such as Self Encrypting Drive (SED) is not in a lockedor foreign state. If yes , unlock
the device then the device before updatingthe firmware.

messages: iDRAC is unable to rekey the device arg1.
records.explanation: The rekey operation on the device identified in the device description failed.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure the device has the latest firmware and resolve any issues thatcould have caused the rekey
to fail.Then try another rekey operation.

messages: The device arg1 is in Local Key Management security mode while iDRAC is in Secure Enterprise Key Manager security mode.
records.explanation: Indicates that a RAID controller in Local Key Management (LKM) security mode has been detected on a server with iDRAC in Secure Enterprise Key Manager (SEKM) security mode. It is recommended to switch the PERC from LKM to SEKM mode.
records.recommended_action:
Use any of the iDRAC interfaces and switch the PERC from LKM to SEKM mode. If the current PERC
firmware version does not have the PERC LKM to SEKM transition capability then update the PERC
firmware to a version that supports the transition.

messages: iDRAC is unable to communicate with the device arg1. Issue details: arg2.
records.explanation: The iDRAC is unable to successfully communicate with the device identified by the device name via out of band. This can occur for several reasons which include: improper device seating, device firmware error or iDRAC firmware error.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure of the following and retry the operation: 1) Device supports the security protocol by
using SMBus (TCG Opal or TCG Enterprise). 2) The Send and Receive commands of security are
supported by SMBus. 3) Ensure the device is operating correctly in the host Operating System.
4) Ensure the device and iDRAC firmware are current. 5) Run the following RACADM command
at the Command Line Interface (CLI) and retry the operation: racadm racreset. 6) Ensure the
device is properly installed. 7) Ensure cabling is correctly installed. 8) If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: iDRAC has used the SEKM-LKC cached key because iDRAC could not retrieve the key from the Key Management Server.
records.explanation: Indicates that iDRAC has used the locally cached key to unlock secured devices. This is because iDRAC was unable to start communication with the external Key Management Server for the specified KMSConnectionTimeout value.
records.cause: Indicates that iDRAC has used the locally cached key to unlock secured devices. This is because iDRAC was unable to start communication with the external Key Management Server for the specified KMSConnectionTimeout value.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following:1) Make sure that the network connection is available between Key Management
Server and iDRAC.2) Make sure that iDRAC has access to the required key ID on the Key
Management Server.

messages: The process of securing the drive arg1 is initiated.
records.explanation: The drive identified in the message is secured successfully. An internal update operation is in progress.
records.recommended_action: Check the lifecycle log for SEKM080 message for completion of the drive securing process.

messages: iDRAC is to unable to set the Encryption Key Manager status of the device arg1 because of an issue in communicating with the device. ErrorStatus:arg2.
records.explanation: iDRAC cannot set the the EKMStatus for the device identified in the message because communicating with device failed.
records.cause: iDRAC cannot set the the EKMStatus for the device identified in the message because communicating with device failed.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure of the following and retry the operation: 1) PERC has the latest firmware. 2) Connection
between iDRAC and PERC is active.

messages: Unable to transition the security mode from Secure Enterprise Key Manager (SEKM) to iDRAC Local Key management (iLKM) because the SEKM mode is in an unverified or failed state.
records.explanation: The security mode cannot be transitioned from Secure Enterprise Key Manager (SEKM) to iDRAC Local Key management (iLKM) because the SEKM mode is in an unverified or failed state.
records.cause: The security mode cannot be transitioned from Secure Enterprise Key Manager (SEKM) to iDRAC Local Key management (iLKM) because the SEKM mode is in an unverified or failed state.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that one or more of the following is correct and retry the operation: 1) The Key
Management Server (KMS) is working and responding. 2) A proper network connection is available
to the KMS. 3) The Key Management Server and iDRAC are configured properly. For more information
about configuring the SEKM or iLKM mode on iDRAC, see the iDRAC Users Guide available on the
support site.

messages: An unknown system hardware failure detected.
records.explanation: The operating system or BIOS detected an unknown event. (IPMI sensor type code 12h - offset 02h).
records.recommended_action:
Reduce system to minimum supported configuration. If issues persists, Collect a SupportAssist
collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-online/
contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a resolution.

messages: No bootable media found.
records.explanation: System setup displays the system boot order. The local video screen may also show additional information. (IPMI sensor type code 1eh - offset 00h).
records.recommended_action: Check system boot settings. Check mass storage controller configuration settings is applicable.

messages: Non-bootable diskette detected.
records.explanation: The disk in the drive is not formatted correctly or does not contain the necessary operating system files(IPMI sensor type code 1eh - offset 01h).
records.recommended_action: Replace diskette with bootable disk.

messages: Invalid boot sector found.
records.explanation: The disk in the drive is not formatted correctly or does not contain the necessary operating system files (IPMI sensor type code 1eh - offset 03h).
records.recommended_action: Replace diskette with bootable disk.

messages: A time-out occurred while waiting for user to select a boot source.
records.explanation: The system has failed to boot to an operating system and needs the user to select a boot source. (IPMI sensor type code 1eh - offset 04h).
records.recommended_action: Select boot source within the time allowed.

messages: Chassis management controller/Management Module (CMC/MM) redundancy is lost.
records.explanation: An action or failure has taken place that breaks CMC/MM redundancy. This includes loss of network connection, hardware failures, firmware update, firmware mismatch between CMCs/MMs, CMC/MM reset, and unplugging a CMC/MM.
records.recommended_action:
Check CMC/MM network cables and network connections. Check that CMC/MM firmware versions
match.

messages: Chassis management controller/Management Module (CMC/MM) redundancy is degraded.
records.explanation: An action or failure has taken place that degrades CMC/MM redundancy. This includes firmware mismatch between CMCs/MMs and a CMC/MM missing SD card.
records.recommended_action: Chassis management controller/Management Module (CMC/MM) redundancy is degraded.

messages: The chassis management controller/Management Module (CMC/MM) is not redundant. Insufficient resources to maintain normal operations.
records.explanation: There is not enough available power for two CMCs/MMs to operate.
records.recommended_action: Check overall power consumption and power status.

messages: Lost communications with Chassis Group Member arg1.
records.explanation: The primary CMC/MM has lost communication with the indicated member CMC/MM.
records.recommended_action: Check network cable and network connections.

messages: Unable to read the temperature from the inlet temperature sensor because of internal issues. This condition may impact server performance.
records.explanation: The inlet temperature sensor measures the temperature of air entering the system. The inlet temperature is located on the front of the server, either in the control panel, right control panel or right rack ear, or front IO module. iDRAC is unable to read temperatures from this sensor because of an issue in the control panel, the cable that connects the control panel or the iDRAC firmware.
records.cause: The inlet temperature sensor measures the temperature of air entering the system. The inlet temperature is located on the front of the server, either in the control panel, right control panel or right rack ear, or front IO module. iDRAC is unable to read temperatures from this sensor because of an issue in the control panel, the cable that connects the control panel or the iDRAC firmware.
records.recommended_action:
Do one or all of the following: 1) Perform a virtual AC Cycle or disconnect and reconnect the input
power cords. 2) Manually remove and reinstall the cable that connects the control panel, right control
panel, and front IO module. 3) Update iDRAC firmware to the latest version available.

messages: One of the I2C sensor is not responding or is not working properly. The status of Sensor health is critical.
records.explanation: An I2C sensor is not responding either because it is damaged, or because of damaged circuit lines for I2C bus, or a faulty sensor state.
records.cause: An I2C sensor is not responding either because it is damaged, or because of damaged circuit lines for I2C bus, or a faulty sensor state.
records.recommended_action:
To find the sensor number that is not responding, type "racadm getsel -E" and check the Event Data
Byte 1. To recover the sensor from the faulty state, do one of the following: 1) Reset iDRAC: a) By
using graphical user interface (GUI), click Overview > Server > Quick Launch Tasks > Reset iDRAC. b)
by running RACADM command at the command line interface (CLI), enter racadm racreset. 2) Change
the corresponding I2C sensor by contacting your service provider.

messages: The sleds are automatically turned off because of a power button press simulation triggered by Chassis Controller.
records.explanation: The sleds are automatically turned off because of a power button press simulation triggered by Chassis Controller. An I2C sensor in not correctly responding because of a corrupted signal in the sensor.
records.cause: The sleds are automatically turned off because of a power button press simulation triggered by Chassis Controller. An I2C sensor in not correctly responding because of a corrupted signal in the sensor.
records.recommended_action:
Check the firmware version of Fan Controller Block (FCB) and make sure that the Power Supply Unit
(PSU) is functional. For more information about the firmware version and PSU ratings, see PSQN
SLN300669 available on the support site.

messages: The sleds are automatically turned off because of a power button release simulation triggered by Chassis Controller.
records.explanation: The sleds are automatically turned off because of a power button release simulation triggered by Chassis Controller. An I2C sensor in not correctly responding because of a corrupted signal in the sensor.
records.cause: The sleds are automatically turned off because of a power button release simulation triggered by Chassis Controller. An I2C sensor in not correctly responding because of a corrupted signal in the sensor.
records.recommended_action:
Check the firmware version of Fan Controller Block (FCB) and make sure that the Power Supply Unit
(PSU) is functional. For more information about the firmware version and PSU ratings, see PSQN
SLN300669 available on the support site.

messages: SAS IOM arg1 could not establish communication with SAS IOM arg2 due to a communication fault.
records.explanation: The SAS IOM devices identified in the message could not communicate with each other via the inter IOM link.
records.recommended_action:
Reseat the SAS IOM devices one at a time and retry the operation. For information about managing
SAS IOM devices, refer to the OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version Users Guide available on the
support site.

messages: The SAS IOM is currently configured for redundancy but SAS IOM arg1 has a firmware mismatch with SAS IOM arg2.
records.explanation: The SAS IOM is currently configured for redundancy but the firmware version of the SAS IOM devices identified in the message do not match.
records.recommended_action:
Update the firmware version and retry the operation. If the issue, persists, replace the SAS IOM.
For information about managing SAS IOM devices, refer to OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version
Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: The SAS IOM device redundancy is degraded.
records.explanation: This event indicates that the SAS IOM has been configured for dual domain operation but only one module is currently present.
records.recommended_action:
Insert a SAS IOM device into the empty slot and retry the operation. For information about managing
SAS IOM devices, refer to OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version Users Guide available on the
support site.

messages: Unable to update the firmware version of the device because of an internal error.
records.explanation: Unable to update the firmware version of the device because of an internal error.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the firmware update operation. If the issue persists, contact your service provider. For
information about updating devices, refer to OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version Users Guide
available on the support site.

messages: Unable to update the firmware because the firmware image file is invalid.
records.explanation: The firmware version cannot be updated because the firmware image file is invalid. This could indicate conditions such as corrupted or unsigned package.
records.cause: The firmware version cannot be updated because the firmware image file is invalid. This could indicate conditions such as corrupted or unsigned package.
records.recommended_action:
Use a valid firmware image file that is compatible with SAS IOM or storage enclosure hardware,
and then retry the firmware update operation. For information about updating devices, refer to
OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: SAS IOM could not establish communication with the drive at location arg1.
records.explanation: The SAS IOM device cannot communicate with the drive available at the location identified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the operation. If the issue persists, replace the drive. For information about managing SAS IOM
devices, refer to OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: Storage enclosure in Chassis Slot arg1 has expanders with different firmware.
records.explanation: This event indicates that the expanders within a storage module have different firmware versions.
records.recommended_action:
Flash the Expanders with the latest firmware. For information about managing SAS IOM devices, refer
to OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: SAS IOM arg1 has a configuration mismatch with SAS IOM arg2.
records.explanation: There is a configuration mismatch between the SAS IOM devices identified in the message.
records.cause: The configuration mismatch could be due to incorrect SAS IOM movement.
records.recommended_action:
The configuration mismatch could be due to incorrect SAS IOM movement. Choose the ForceActive
option in OpenManage Enterprise - Modular to override the mismatch and use the local configuration,
and then apply to both SAS IOMs.

messages: SAS IOM arg1 has a configuration that is not consistent with chassis.
records.explanation: This event indicates that the foreign SAS IOMs are inserted to the chassis.
records.cause: The configuration mismatch could be due to incorrect switch movement.
records.recommended_action:
The configuration mismatch could be due to incorrect switch movement. Do one of the following: 1)
Replace the switch. 2) Run the ForceActive command at the command line interface to override the
mismatch and use the local configuration, and then apply to both switches.

messages: SAS IOM arg1 has inconsistent firmware versions in its components.
records.explanation: The SAS IOM device identified in the message has inconsistent firmware versions in its components such as SoC, IOC, and expander.
records.recommended_action: Update the SAS IOM with the latest firmware version.

messages: SAS IOM arg1 requires a power-cycle operation to enable the new firmware version.
records.explanation: The SAS IOM device identified in the message requires a power-cycle operation to enable the new firmware version.
records.recommended_action: Power cycle the SAS IOM device identified in the message.

messages: The SAS fabric for SAS IOM arg1 is unable to manage the storage assignment.
records.explanation: The SAS IOM device identified in the message is unable to manage the storage assignment.
records.recommended_action:
Resolve an error condition in one of more SAS IOMs. For information about managing SAS IOM
devices, refer to OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: The SAS IOM arg1 has detected multiple ECC memory errors.
records.explanation: The SAS IOM device identified in the message has detected multiple Error-correcting Code (ECC) errors.
records.recommended_action:
Replace the SAS IOM device. For information about managing SAS IOM devices, refer to the
MX5000s SAS IOM Installation Guide available on the support site.

messages: A mismatch is observed in the SAS IOMs because of incorrect SAS IOM movement between the chassis.
records.explanation: A mismatch is observed in the SAS IOMs because of incorrect SAS IOM movement between chassis or configuration changes.
records.cause: A mismatch is observed in the SAS IOMs because of incorrect SAS IOM movement between chassis or configuration changes.
records.recommended_action:
On the OpenManage Enterprise - Modular, select ForceActive (Devices-> I/O Modules-> Overview->
More Actions) to override the mismatch. The local configuration on the selected IOM will be applied to
both the SAS IOMs.

messages: The SAS IOM is currently configured for redundancy and the hot-spare SAS IOM is not available in the slot.
records.explanation: The SAS IOM is currently configured for redundancy and the hot-spare SAS IOM is not available in the slot.
records.recommended_action:
Insert a SAS IOM device into the empty slot and retry the operation. For information about managing
SAS IOM devices, refer to OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version Users Guide available on the
support site.

messages: The SAS IOM is currently configured for redundancy and communication with the hot-spare SAS IOM has ended.
records.explanation: The SAS IOM is currently configured for redundancy and communication with the hot-spare SAS IOM has ended.
records.recommended_action:
Reseat the SAS IOM devices one by one and retry the operation. For information about managing SAS
IOM devices, refer to OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version Users Guide available on the support
site.

messages: The SAS IOM is currently configured for redundancy but the firmware version is different from the hot-spare SAS IOM.
records.explanation: The SAS IOM is currently configured for redundancy but the firmware version is different from the hot-spare SAS IOM.
records.recommended_action:
Update the firmware version and retry the operation. For information about managing SAS IOM
devices, refer to OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: The SAS IOM is currently configured for redundancy but the storage assignment is different from partner SAS IOM.
records.explanation: There is a configuration mismatch between the SAS IOM devices identified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
On the OpenManage Enterprise - Modular, select the clear configuration (Devices-> I/O Modules->
Overview-> More Actions-> Clear Configuration) option to override this mismatch.

messages: The Device must be power cycled for the new firmware version to take effect.
records.explanation: The device does not have the updated firmware version. Device must be power cycled for the new firmware version to take effect.
records.recommended_action: The device must be power cycled for the new firmware version to take effect.

messages: An internal error is observed on the SAS IOM or Storage modules.
records.explanation: An internal error is observed on the SAS IOM or Storage modules.
records.recommended_action:
An error condition exists in one or more SAS IOM/storage modules. For information about managing
SAS IOM devices, refer to OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version Users Guide available on the
support site.

messages: Unable to communicate with one or more internal components of SAS IOM because of internal errors.
records.explanation: Unable to communicate with one or more internal components of SAS IOM because of internal errors.
records.recommended_action:
Reseat the SAS IOM. For information about managing SAS IOM devices, refer to OpenManage
Enterprise Modular Version Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: A SAS IOM in the chassis is unconfigured.
records.explanation: A SAS IOM in the chassis is unconfigured.
records.recommended_action:
Configure the SAS IOM. For information about managing SAS IOM devices, refer to OpenManage
Enterprise Modular Version Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: A drive is in a predictive failure state.
records.explanation: This event indicates that a drive is in a predictive failure state.
records.recommended_action: Replace the Drive.

messages: The firmware version on the Storage module requires a power cycle to become effective.
records.explanation: The firmware version on the Storage module requires a power cycle to become effective.
records.recommended_action:
Power cycle the Storage module device. For information about managing SAS IOM devices, refer to
OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: The device is in unrecoverable state as reported by SES (SCSI Enclosure Services).
records.explanation: The device is in unrecoverable state as reported by SES (SCSI Enclosure Services).
records.recommended_action:
Check the device status, and then replace if necessary. If the issue persists, contact your service
provider.

messages: A topology issue is detected in the SAS Fabric.
records.explanation: A topology issue is detected in the SAS Fabric.
records.recommended_action:
Check the physical connections of all devices in the fabric including SAS IOM, SAS IOM ports, storage
modules and disk drives.

messages: The storage assignment on the SAS IOMs does not match.
records.explanation: The storage assignment on the SAS IOMs does not match.
records.recommended_action:
Use the ForceActive Action to apply the storage assignment from one of the SAS IOM. For
information about managing SAS IOM devices, refer to OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version
Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: Unable to update the SAS IOM firmware version because the SAS IOM has inconsistent firmware versions on the internal components such as SoC, IOC, and expander.
records.explanation: Unable to update the SAS IOM firmware version because the SAS IOM has inconsistent firmware versions on the internal components such as SoC, IOC, and expander.
records.cause: Unable to update the SAS IOM firmware version because the SAS IOM has inconsistent firmware versions on the internal components such as SoC, IOC, and expander.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that the firmware version of SAS IOM components are consistent and retry the operation.
For information about managing SAS IOM devices, refer to OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version
Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: The drawer of the storage enclosure is opened while hot-plugging the drives.
records.explanation: The drawer of the storage enclosure is opened while hot-plugging the drives.
records.recommended_action:
Close the drawer of the storage enclosure. For information about managing SAS IOM devices, refer to
OpenManage Enterprise Modular Version Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: One of the hot-swappable expanders of the storage enclosures is unable to update the firmware version (with no recovery option).
records.explanation: One of the hot-swappable expanders of the storage enclosures is unable to update the firmware version (with no recovery option).
records.recommended_action:
Replace the Hot swappable expander of the storage enclosure. If the issue persists, contact your
service provider. For information about managing SAS IOM devices, refer to OpenManage Enterprise
Modular Version Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: The SAS IOM has a degraded SAS connection between IOM arg1 and storage enclosure in chassis slot arg2.
records.explanation: The SAS IOM has a degraded SAS connection between a SAS IOM and a storage enclosure identified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
Do the following: 1) Make sure that the compute sleds that have storage assignment to affected
storage enclosures are turned off and then reseat the storage enclosure. 2) If the issue persists,
reseat the storage expanders one at a time. 3) If problem persists, reseat the IOM.

messages: Unable to retrieve Storage Controller Logs because no storage controllers are detected in the server.
records.explanation: Unable to retrieve Storage Controller Logs because no storage controllers are detected in the server.
records.cause: Unable to retrieve Storage Controller Logs because no storage controllers are detected in the server.
records.recommended_action: Make sure that at least one storage controller is present in the server, and then retry the operation.

messages: Unable to export Storage Controller Log information of arg1 because of an issue in communicating with the controller.
records.explanation: The Storage Controller Log information of the controller identified in the message cannot be exported because of an issue in communicating with the controller.
records.cause: The Storage Controller Log information of the controller identified in the message cannot be exported because of an issue in communicating with the controller.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure that server is not in BIOS POST mode, and then retry the operation. Use the
GetRemoteServicesAPIStatus() invoke method and check for output parameter RTStatus and make
sure it shows 0 (ready status), and then retry the operation. If the issue persists, reset iDRAC and
retry the operation.

messages: Unable to export Storage Controller Log information for controller arg1 because the export did not complete within the allocated time.
records.explanation: The Storage Controller Log data export did not complete within the allocated time. Currently, the maximum allocated time is 20 minutes.
records.cause: Unable to export Storage Controller Log information for controller arg1 because the export did not complete within the allocated time.
records.recommended_action:
Reset the iDRAC and retry the operation. To reset the iDRAC using the RACADM command line utility,
enter "racadm racreset".

messages: Unable to retrieve the Storage Controller Log because another operation is in progress on the storage controller arg1.
records.explanation: The Storage Controller Log cannot be retrieved because another operation is in progress on the storage controller identified in the message.
records.cause: The Storage Controller Log cannot be retrieved because another operation is in progress on the storage controller identified in the message.
records.recommended_action:
View the job queue, make sure that all jobs are in completed state, and then retry the operation. To
view the job queue using RACADM command line utility, enter "racadm jobqueue view".

messages: Unable to start the Storage Controller Log collection because the server is powered off.
records.explanation: Unable to start the Storage Controller Log collection because the server is powered off.
records.cause: Unable to start the Storage Controller Log collection because the server is powered off.
records.recommended_action: Turn on the server, wait until the OS finishes booting, and then retry the operation.

messages: Unable to start the Storage Controller Log collection because the server is in POST and has not finished the startup process.
records.explanation: The Storage Controller Log collection operation cannot be started because the server is in POST and has not finished the startup process.
records.cause: The Storage Controller Log collection operation cannot be started because the server is in POST and has not finished the startup process.
records.recommended_action: Wait until the server completes POST and the OS startup process, and then retry the operation.

messages: Unable to start the operation because the iDRAC Service Module (iSM) service running on the server operating system (OS) is not compatible with iDRAC firmware version installed on the server.
records.explanation: The operation cannot be started because iDRAC Service Module (iSM) running on the server operating system (OS) is not compatible with iDRAC firmware version installed on the server.
records.cause: The operation cannot be started because iDRAC Service Module (iSM) running on the server operating system (OS) is not compatible with iDRAC firmware version installed on the server.
records.recommended_action:
Install the compatible version of iDRAC Service Module (iSM) on the server operating system (OS)
and then retry the operation. Refer to the iSM Installation Guide for details on the compatible
versions.

messages: Unable to complete the operation because the Operating System-Baseboard Management Controller Pass Through (OS-BMC PT) required for communication with iDRAC Service Module (iSM) is not enabled.
records.explanation: The operation cannot be completed because the Operating System-Baseboard Management Controller Pass Through (OS-BMC PT) required for communication with iDRAC Service Module (iSM) is not enabled.
records.cause: The operation cannot be completed because the Operating System-Baseboard Management Controller Pass Through (OS-BMC PT) required for communication with iDRAC Service Module (iSM) is not enabled.
records.recommended_action:
Enable the Operating System-Baseboard Management Controller Pass Through (OS-BMC PT) and
then retry the operation. To enable the OS-BMC PT using the RACADM command line utility, enter
"racadm set idrac.os-bmc.AdminState Enabled".

messages: iDRAC is unable to collect the Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) debug log data because of an invalid response from the GPU Baseboard.
records.explanation: iDRAC is unable to collect the Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) debug log data because of an invalid response from the GPU Baseboard.
records.cause: iDRAC is unable to collect the Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) debug log data because of an invalid response from the GPU Baseboard.
records.recommended_action:
Retry SupportAssist collection and select the GPU Debug Log option. If the issue persists, Collect
a SupportAssist collection (TSR) report using iDRAC. Visit https://www.dell.com/support/incidents-
online/contactus/dynamic to use the Virtual Assistant to analyze the collection and recommend a
resolution.

messages: The arg1 is in read-only mode.
records.explanation: The PCIe solid state device identified in the message is in read-only mode.
records.recommended_action: Back up the data on the device, and contact your service provider for further instructions.

messages: The arg1 is in a security locked state.
records.explanation: The PCIe solid state device identified in the message is in a locked state, because an existing initialization task was interrupted due to a power failure or disk removal.
records.cause: The PCIe solid state device identified in the message is in a locked state, because an existing initialization task was interrupted due to a power failure or disk removal.
records.recommended_action: Run Full Initialize operation on the device identified in the message.

messages: Unable to complete the operation because either the Fully Qualified Device Descriptor (FQDD) entered did not match any virtual drive (VD), the physical drives available, or the operation is not supported on the physical drive (s).
records.explanation: The operation cannot be completed because either the Fully Qualified Device Descriptor (FQDD) entered did not match any virtual drive (VD), the physical drives available, or the operation is not supported on the physical drive (s).
records.cause: The operation cannot be completed because either the Fully Qualified Device Descriptor (FQDD) entered did not match any virtual drive (VD), the physical drives available, or the operation is not supported on the physical drive (s).
records.recommended_action:
Make sure of the following and retry the operation: 1) A physical drive or virtual drive with the FQDD
entered exists. 2) The physical drive (s) supports the operation being tried. For more information
about supported physical drives, see the iDRAC Users Guide available on the support site.

messages: Unable to complete the operation either because the RAID level entered is not supported by the controller, or the current RAIDType of "MD Software RAID" does not allow the operation.
records.explanation: The operation cannot be completed either because the RAID level entered is not supported by the controller, or the current RAIDType of "MD Software RAID" does not allow the operation.
records.cause: The operation cannot be completed either because the RAID level entered is not supported by the controller, or the current RAIDType of "MD Software RAID" does not allow the operation.
records.recommended_action: Enter a valid RAID level and retry the operation.

messages: No RAID controller is displayed.
records.explanation: No RAID controller data to display. The system is powered off, no RAID controller is present in the system, or the RAID controller is not connected to the system.
records.recommended_action:
Check if the server has power, RAID controller is available, and that a RAID controller is connected to
the system.

messages: No physical disks are displayed.
records.explanation: No physical disk data to display. The system is powered off, physical disks are not present on the system, or physical disks are not connected to the enclosure or backplane.
records.recommended_action:
Check if the server has power, physical disks are available, and physical disks are connected to the
enclosure or backplane.

messages: No virtual disks are displayed.
records.explanation: No virtual disk data to display. The system is powered off, physical disks are not present on the system, or virtual disks are not created.
records.recommended_action: Check if the server has power, physical disks are available, and virtual disks are created.

messages: No enclosures are displayed.
records.explanation: No enclosure data to display. The system is powered off, enclosures are not present on the system, or enclosures are not connected to the RAID controllers.
records.recommended_action:
Check if the server has power, enclosures are available, and enclosures are connected to the RAID
controllers.

messages: Fans are not connected to enclosures or data about fans is unavailable.
records.explanation: No fan data to display. The system is powered off, no fan enclosures are present in the system, or the fans are not connected to the enclosures.
records.recommended_action: Check if the server has power, enclosure fan is available, and fan is connected to the enclosure.

messages: Power supply unit is not connected to the enclosure or data about power supply unit is unavailable.
records.explanation: No power supply unit data to display. The system is powered off, no power supply unit is present in the system, or the power supply unit is not connected to the enclosure.
records.recommended_action:
Check if the server has power, enclosure power supply unit is available, and power supply unit is
connected to the enclosure.

messages: Provided Physical disk not valid for this operation.
records.explanation: One or more of the specified physical disks cannot be used for the operation requested. Physical disk protocol and media type, along with other physical disk characteristics like Secure Encryption and T10 protection, need to match the requirements of the requested operation.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure the specified physical disk has the appropriate protocol and media type for the requested
operation. Specify a different physical disk with a state appropriate for the requested operation and
retry the operation.

messages: Maximum virtual disks allowed for this controller has been reached.
records.explanation: A new virtual disk cannot be created because the maximum number of virtual disks are already created.
records.cause: A new virtual disk cannot be created because the maximum number of virtual disks are already created.
records.recommended_action: A new virtual disk cannot be created until one is deleted.

messages: The physical disk specified is not large enough to be a hot spare for this virtual disk.
records.explanation: The physical disk drive cannot be assigned as the hot-spare of this virtual disk because the capacity of the physical disk is not sufficient.
records.cause: The physical disk drive cannot be assigned as the hot-spare of this virtual disk because the capacity of the physical disk is not sufficient.
records.recommended_action:
Specify a physical disk with a larger capacity or replace the specified physical disk with one with more
capacity, and then retry the operation.

messages: The specified Virtual Disk is not valid for the operation.
records.explanation: The virtual disk specified is not compatible with the requested operation or a specified operation parameter is not appropriate for the virtual disk type specified.
records.recommended_action:
Make sure the operation parameters are appropriate for the virtual disk type. Specify a compatible
virtual disk for the requested operation and retry the operation.

messages: No foreign configurations detected.
records.explanation: This operation did not detect any foreign drives. This may be because no foreign drives are present or the only foreign drives are in a secured locked state.
records.cause: This operation did not detect any foreign drives. This may be because no foreign drives are present or the only foreign drives are in a secured locked state.
records.recommended_action:
If the only foreign drives present are in a secured locked state, run a secure erase operation on the
drives to securely erase data or unlock these drives and retry the operation. Otherwise the operation
was not successful because there are no foreign drives.

messages: The configuration file (Path: arg1) that contains firmware and driver information for arg2 is not updated or is incorrectly formatted to complete the comparison.
records.explanation: Storage Services is unable to determine whether the system has the minimum required versions of the RAID controller firmware and drivers because a configuration file is not readable, corrupted, or has missing data.
records.cause: Storage Services is unable to determine whether the system has the minimum required versions of the RAID controller firmware and drivers because a configuration file is not readable, corrupted, or has missing data.
records.recommended_action: Reinstall Server Administrator and Storage Services.

messages: The current operating system kernel version and the non-RAID SCSI driver version are older than the minimum required versions.
records.explanation: The version of the operating system kernel and the driver do not meet the minimum requirements. Storage Services may not be able to display or perform storage management functions until the system meets the minimum requirements.
records.recommended_action:
See the Readme file on the installation media for operating system kernel and driver version
requirements. Update the system to meet the minimum requirements and then reinstall Storage
Services.

messages: The non-RAID SCSI driver version is older than the minimum required version.
records.explanation: The driver version does not meet the minimum requirements and Storage Services cannot perform the required operations until the minimum requirements are met.
records.recommended_action:
See the Readme file for the driver requirements and update the system to meet the minimum
requirements and reinstall Storage Services.

messages: The arg1 has failed.
records.explanation: The device (physical disk or an enclosure) identified in the message has failed. The device (physical disk or an enclosure) failure was detected while performing a rescan. However, physical disk failures are also detected during a check consistency operation.
records.recommended_action:
Replace the identified device. A failed device is indicated with a red color "X" status icon. Perform a
rescan after replacing the failed device.

messages: Virtual Disk name is not supported.
records.explanation: Setting the Virtual disk name is not a valid operation on the specified controller.
records.recommended_action: Do not specify the virtual disk name and retry the operation.

messages: Virtual disk not found.
records.explanation: The requested operation cannot be completed because the specified virtual disk is not found.
records.recommended_action: Provide a valid virtual disk FQDD (Fully Qualified Device Descriptor) and retry the operation.

messages: Physical disk not found.
records.explanation: The requested operation cannot be completed because the specified physical disk is not found.
records.recommended_action: Provide a valid physical disk FQDD (Fully Qualified Device Descriptor) and retry the operation.

messages: Unable to perform operation because there are one or more Secure Virtual Disks associated with the controller.
records.explanation: Unable to perform operation because there are one or more Secure Virtual Disks associated with the controller.
records.cause: Unable to perform operation because there are one or more Secure Virtual Disks associated with the controller.
records.recommended_action: Delete the Secure Virtual Disk(s) associated with this controller and retry the operation.

messages: All physical disks specified are not part of the same disk group.
records.explanation: One or more physical disks specified to create virtual disk (VD) is not valid because it is not part of the same disk group.
records.cause: One or more physical disks specified to create virtual disk (VD) is not valid because it is not part of the same disk group.
records.recommended_action:
Enumerate existing virtual disks to find the physical disks of the same disk group. Specify physical
disks that are of the same disk group and retry the operation.

messages: StartingLBA and Size parameters are required to create a virtual disk.
records.explanation: The specified physical disks have fragmented disk space, therefore StartingLBA and Size parameters are required to be specified in order to create a virtual disk.
records.recommended_action: Specify StartingLBA and Size parameters and retry the operation.

messages: The specified StartingLBA and Size values combination result in an overlapping virtual disk.
records.explanation: Unable to complete the create virtual disk operation because the StartingLBA and Size value combination results in an overlapping virtual disk.
records.cause: Unable to complete the create virtual disk operation because the StartingLBA and Size value combination results in an overlapping virtual disk.
records.recommended_action: Refer to the users guide to provide the correct StartingLBA and Size combination values.

messages: Unable to configure RAID.
records.explanation: Unable to create a virtual disk due to unknown reasons.
records.recommended_action:
Do one of the following and retry the operation: 1) Exit the RAID Configuration wizard. 2) Update
the RAID controller firmware to the latest version. 3) Reboot the system and press the <F10> key to
re-enter Lifecycle Controller, and retry the operation.

messages: Unable to launch RAID Configuration wizard.
records.explanation: No RAID controller is installed on the system.
records.recommended_action:
Install the RAID controller and do the following: 1) Reboot the system. 2) Press the <F10> key to
re-enter Lifecycle Controller. 3) Retry RAID configuration.

messages: Unable to delete virtual disks.
records.explanation: Unable to delete the existing virtual disks for unknown reasons.
records.recommended_action:
Exit the RAID Configuration wizard and retry the operation. If the problem persists do the following: 1)
Reboot the system. 2) Press the <F10> key to re-enter Lifecycle Controller. 3) Retry the operation.

messages: Unable to create virtual disk.
records.explanation: The physical disk is unreadable or the RAID controller is not responding.
records.recommended_action:
Exit Lifecycle Controller, press the <F10> key to re-enter Lifecycle Controller, and retry the operation.
If the problem persists, replace the physical disk or update the RAID controller firmware to the latest
version, and retry the operation.

messages: Insufficient physical disk space on selected RAID controller.
records.explanation: The RAID controller does not have sufficient number of initialized physical disks or adequate disk space to create the requested virtual disk.
records.recommended_action:
Connect additional physical disks to the RAID controller, initialize the physical disks, and retry the
operation. To initialize the physical disks, reboot the system and select Option ROM during system
startup.

messages: No supported controllers present for RAID configuration.
records.explanation: Unable to configure RAID as the supported RAID controller is not present.
records.recommended_action:
Install a supported RAID controller and the required number of physical disks for the RAID
configuration, and retry the operation.

messages: StartingLBA and Size value combination is greater than allowed by the physical disk size.
records.explanation: The requested operation cannot be completed because the specified StartingLBA and Size value combination is greater than allowed by the physical disk size.
records.cause: The requested operation cannot be completed because the specified StartingLBA and Size value combination is greater than allowed by the physical disk size.
records.recommended_action:
Specify the Size value only and allow the instrumentation to calculate the StartingLBA value then retry
the operation.

messages: Encryption configuration failed.
records.explanation: Unable to apply the RAID controller encryption because RAID controller is not responding.
records.cause: Unable to apply the RAID controller encryption because RAID controller is not responding.
records.recommended_action:
Retry the operation. If the problem persists, reboot the system or update the RAID controller firmware
to the latest version and retry the operation.

messages: Unable to encrypt virtual disks.
records.explanation: Unable to encrypt unsecure virtual disks due to an internal error.
records.recommended_action:
Exit Lifecycle Controller, press the <F10> key to re-enter Lifecycle Controller, and retry the operation.
If the problem persists, update the RAID controller firmware to the latest version and retry the
operation.

messages: Unable to initialize the selected physical disk drive(s).
records.explanation: The physical disk drive(s) cannot be initialized because the selected RAID controller does not support this operation while in non-RAID mode.
records.cause: The physical disk drive(s) cannot be initialized because the selected RAID controller does not support this operation while in non-RAID mode.
records.recommended_action:
Do one of the following: 1) Select a controller that is in RAID mode and retry the operation. 2) Update
the controller firmware to the latest version and retry the operation.

messages: Initializing virtual disk is not supported on the RAID controller.
records.explanation: The initializing virtual disk operation is not supported on the target device.
records.recommended_action:
For more information about supported operations, see the documentation specific for the targeted
RAID controller or the Lifecycle Controller Remote Services Quick Start Guide.

messages: Unable to assign the specified virtual disk to multiple Virtual Adapters in single assignment mode.
records.explanation: In order to prevent data loss, the system has prevented the assignment of a Virtual Disk to multiple Virtual Adapters because the clustered assignment mode is not enabled.
records.cause: In order to prevent data loss, the system has prevented the assignment of a Virtual Disk to multiple Virtual Adapters because the clustered assignment mode is not enabled.
records.recommended_action:
Enable clustered assignment mode or unassign the virtual disk from the Virtual Adapter it is currently
assigned to and retry the operation.

messages: One or more physical disks specified for creating a virtual disk do not have the same block size.
records.explanation: Unable to create the requested virtual disk because the physical disks specified did not have the same block size.
records.cause: Unable to create the requested virtual disk because the physical disks specified did not have the same block size.
records.recommended_action:
Verify that the physical disks selected for creating the virtual disk have the same block size and retry
the operation. The block size can be determined by reviewing the physical disk inventory and checking
the BlockSize property for each physical disk.

messages: One or more physical disks specified for creating a virtual disk are not T10 Protection Information capable.
records.explanation: Unable to create the requested virtual disk because one or more specified physical disk(s) is not T10 Protection Information capable.
records.cause: Unable to create the requested virtual disk because one or more specified physical disk(s) is not T10 Protection Information capable.
records.recommended_action:
Verify that the physical disks selected for creating a virtual disk are T10 Protection Information
capable, and then retry the operation.

messages: Controller is not T10 Protection Information capable.
records.explanation: The requested operation did not succeed because the selected RAID controller is not T10 Protection Information capable.
records.cause: The requested operation did not succeed because the selected RAID controller is not T10 Protection Information capable.
records.recommended_action:
Verify that the RAID controller selected for the operation is T10 Protection Information capable, and
then retry the operation.

messages: Controller does not support uneven span RAID10 virtual disks.
records.explanation: The operation did not succeed since the selected controller does not support creating uneven span RAID10 virtual disks.
records.recommended_action:
The selected controller is not capable of creating an uneven span RAID10 virtual disk. Specify the
proper span length and span depth combination for creating RAID10 virtual disk on the selected
controller, and then retry the operation.

messages: Unable to perform the requested RAID configuration because the Lifecycle Controller version on the server does not have the necessary capabilities.
records.explanation: The requested RAID configuration operation did not succeed because the Lifecycle Controller version on the target server does not have the necessary capabilities.
records.cause: The requested RAID configuration operation did not succeed because the Lifecycle Controller version on the target server does not have the necessary capabilities.
records.recommended_action:
Check the Lifecycle Controller version on the target server and update it with the latest version
available.

messages: Storage objects are unavailable in the current system configuration.
records.explanation: There are no RAID controllers, physical disks or virtual disks discovered by instrumentation that can be configured.
records.recommended_action:
Storage objects are unavailable in the current system configuration. Make sure that the storage
devices are installed in the system, and then retry the operation after the Collect System Inventory On
Restart (CSIOR) feature has updated the system inventory.

messages: The Span Count is not valid for creating a RAID 10. Valid Span counts are arg1.
